blocks.html_en: In total, 82 HCMI models were from patients who received immunotherapy and 25 models were established from tumours that had previously been exposed to an immunotherapeutic. With respect to biomarkers relevant to immunotherapy resistance, we observed an expected range of expression of PDL1 and PDL2 and HLA allele-specific expression loss. Notably, one melanoma model, HCM-BROD-0710, had a JAK2.p1013F mutation (Extended Data Fig. 9d), a rare immune-evasion alteration48. These findings highlight the utility of HCMI models and data in dissecting molecular mechanisms of cell-intrinsic responses to immunotherapy.

sentences.en: In total, 82 HCMI models were from patients who received immunotherapy and 25 models were established from tumours that had previously been exposed to an immunotherapeutic.
sentences.zh: 总共有 82 个 HCMI 模型来自接受免疫治疗的患者，25 个模型是从之前接受过免疫治疗的肿瘤建立的。

sentences.en: With respect to biomarkers relevant to immunotherapy resistance, we observed an expected range of expression of PDL1 and PDL2 and HLA allele-specific expression loss.
sentences.zh: 对于与免疫治疗耐药性相关的生物标志物，我们观察到 PDL1 和 PDL2 的预期表达范围以及 HLA 等位基因特异性表达丧失。

sentences.en: Notably, one melanoma model, HCM-BROD-0710, had a JAK2.p1013F mutation (Extended Data Fig. 9d), a rare immune-evasion alteration48.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，一种黑色素瘤模型 HCM-BROD-0710 具有 JAK2.p1013F 突变（扩展数据图 9d），这是一种罕见的免疫逃避改变48。

sentences.en: These findings highlight the utility of HCMI models and data in dissecting molecular mechanisms of cell-intrinsic responses to immunotherapy.
sentences.zh: 这些发现强调了 HCMI 模型和数据在剖析细胞内在免疫治疗反应的分子机制方面的实用性。

blocks.html_en: Previous studies have shown that intrinsic and acquired resistance to the chemotherapy temozolomide is associated with mismatch repair (MMR) deficiency49,50,51. Examination of the GBM models revealed the presence of MMR mutational signatures linked to intrinsic resistance (SBS6, SBS15, SBS26 and SBS44) as well as acquired MMR deficiency associated with temozolomide resistance (SBS11) (Fig. 6b). A review of treatment histories showed that HCM-BROD-0648-C71, HCM-BROD-0782-C71 and HCM-BROD-1123-C71 exhibited a high number of treatment cycles of temozolomide exposure (Fig. 6b) and pathogenic mutations in MMR genes (for example, MSH6). The patient from which HCM-BROD-0681-C71 was generated had a germline MMR variant (in MSH2), combined with the SBS11 signature, which was also been associated with long-term temozolomide exposure (820 days) (Fig. 6b). Notably, although the tumour from which HCM-BROD-0925-C71 was generated was subjected to long-term temozolomide exposure (1,484 days), the model lacked the temozolomide-associated SBS11 signature. Further review of the integrated clinical data revealed that this patient’s tumour had an unmethylated MGMT promoter (MGMT proficient), which confers upstream resistance to temozolomide. After exploring ecDNA events with clinical relevance, we observed that the GBM model HCM-BROD-0613-C71 exhibited a MYCN ecDNA amplification and high MYCN expression (Fig. 6c and Extended Data Fig. 9e). These findings highlight the ability to use the linked clinical and molecular HCMI data to study resistance.

sentences.en: Previous studies have shown that intrinsic and acquired resistance to the chemotherapy temozolomide is associated with mismatch repair (MMR) deficiency49,50,51.
sentences.zh: 先前的研究表明，对化疗替莫唑胺的内在和获得性耐药与错配修复 (MMR) 缺陷相关49,50,51。

sentences.en: Examination of the GBM models revealed the presence of MMR mutational signatures linked to intrinsic resistance (SBS6, SBS15, SBS26 and SBS44) as well as acquired MMR deficiency associated with temozolomide resistance (SBS11) (Fig. 6b).
sentences.zh: 对GBM模型的检查揭示了与内在耐药性相关的MMR突变特征（SBS6、SBS15、SBS26和SBS44）的存在以及与替莫唑胺耐药性相关的获得性MMR缺陷（SBS11）（图6b）。

sentences.zh: 对综合临床数据的进一步审查显示，该患者的肿瘤具有未甲基化的 MGMT 启动子（MGMT 熟练），这赋予了替莫唑胺的上游耐药性。

sentences.en: After exploring ecDNA events with clinical relevance, we observed that the GBM model HCM-BROD-0613-C71 exhibited a MYCN ecDNA amplification and high MYCN expression (Fig. 6c and Extended Data Fig. 9e).
sentences.zh: 在探索具有临床相关性的 ecDNA 事件后，我们观察到 GBM 模型 HCM-BROD-0613-C71 表现出 MYCN ecDNA 扩增和高 MYCN 表达（图 6c 和扩展数据图 9e）。

sentences.en: These findings highlight the ability to use the linked clinical and molecular HCMI data to study resistance.
sentences.zh: 这些发现凸显了使用关联的临床和分子 HCMI 数据来研究耐药性的能力。

blocks.html_en: After functional validation, models with the SBS11 signature exhibited significantly attenuated temozolomide sensitivity compared with non-SBS11 counterparts (Wilcoxon P < 0.05), independent of MGMT promoter methylation status (Supplementary Fig. 7a–c). These results confirm that mutational signatures of acquired resistance translate into functional resistance51,52. The MYCN-amplified model HCM-BROD-0613-C71 also displayed temozolomide resistance consistent with an unmethylated MGMT promoter (Supplementary Fig. 7a).

sentences.en: After functional validation, models with the SBS11 signature exhibited significantly attenuated temozolomide sensitivity compared with non-SBS11 counterparts (Wilcoxon P < 0.05), independent of MGMT promoter methylation status (Supplementary Fig. 7a–c).
sentences.zh: 经过功能验证后，与非 SBS11 模型相比，具有 SBS11 特征的模型表现出显着减弱的替莫唑胺敏感性 (Wilcoxon P < 0.05)，与 MGMT 启动子甲基化状态无关（补充图 7a-c）。

sentences.en: These results confirm that mutational signatures of acquired resistance translate into functional resistance51,52.
sentences.zh: 这些结果证实获得性抗性的突变特征转化为功能性抗性51,52。

sentences.en: The MYCN-amplified model HCM-BROD-0613-C71 also displayed temozolomide resistance consistent with an unmethylated MGMT promoter (Supplementary Fig. 7a).
sentences.zh: MYCN 扩增模型 HCM-BROD-0613-C71 也表现出与未甲基化 MGMT 启动子一致的替莫唑胺耐药性（补充图 7a）。

blocks.html_en: Finally, we leveraged germline data to interrogate models related potentially to cancer predisposition syndromes. We identified 13 patients with germline mutations consistent with Lynch syndrome variants, including 5 models with loss-of-function pathogenic variants in MSH2, MSH6, MLH1 or PMS2 (Fig. 6d and Extended Data Fig. 9f). We conducted survival analyses for colorectal cancers among cases associated with Lynch syndrome and noted that these cases had a favourable prognosis (Supplementary Fig. 8). Thus, HCMI models are likely to be valuable for the functional study of germline-driven cancer predisposition disorders.

sentences.en: Finally, we leveraged germline data to interrogate models related potentially to cancer predisposition syndromes.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们利用种系数据来询问与癌症易感综合症潜在相关的模型。

sentences.en: We identified 13 patients with germline mutations consistent with Lynch syndrome variants, including 5 models with loss-of-function pathogenic variants in MSH2, MSH6, MLH1 or PMS2 (Fig. 6d and Extended Data Fig. 9f).
sentences.zh: 我们鉴定了 13 名具有与 Lynch 综合征变异一致的种系突变的患者，其中包括 5 个具有 MSH2、MSH6、MLH1 或 PMS2 功能丧失致病性变异的模型（图 6d 和扩展数据图 9f）。

sentences.en: We conducted survival analyses for colorectal cancers among cases associated with Lynch syndrome and noted that these cases had a favourable prognosis (Supplementary Fig. 8).
sentences.zh: 我们对林奇综合征相关病例中的结直肠癌进行了生存分析，并注意到这些病例的预后良好（补充图8）。

sentences.en: Thus, HCMI models are likely to be valuable for the functional study of germline-driven cancer predisposition disorders.
sentences.zh: 因此，HCMI 模型可能对于种系驱动的癌症易感性疾病的功能研究有价值。

blocks.html_en: To facilitate exploration of the clinical and molecular features and to support translational research, we developed the HCMI Explorer Suite (https://appshare.cancer.gov/HCMI_Explorer_Suite/), an interactive Shiny tool for integrating and visualizing HCMI data (Fig. 6e and Supplementary Fig. 9). The tool provides access to patient treatment histories, model development timelines, genomic profiles and Celligner transcriptional mapping (Fig. 6e), which enables translationally focused users to select optimal models.

sentences.zh: 为了促进临床和分子特征的探索并支持转化研究，我们开发了 HCMI Explorer Suite (https://appshare.cancer.gov/HCMI_Explorer_Suite/)，这是一种用于集成和可视化 HCMI 数据的交互式 Shiny 工具（图 6e 和补充图 9）。

blocks.html_en: Discussion

sentences.zh: 讨论

blocks.html_en: Here we presented the generation and comprehensive molecular characterization of 665 human cancer models and 581 tumours (413 that produced models and 168 from failed derivation attempts), together with detailed clinical characterization of the patients who donated tumour specimens. Notably, such models maintained high concordance with the primary tumour with respect to DNA alterations (97.8%) and RNA expression (92%), despite being cultured for a year or longer ex vivo. This fact and the scale of the resource provide new opportunities for the scientific community to investigate the therapeutic consequences of a wide range of genetic alterations and transcriptional states. For example, the two companion papers26,27 demonstrate that the HCMI models are indeed suitable for high-throughput characterization of genetic dependencies using genome-wide CRISPR–Cas9-based screens and systematic assessments of drug sensitivity.

sentences.en: Here we presented the generation and comprehensive molecular characterization of 665 human cancer models and 581 tumours (413 that produced models and 168 from failed derivation attempts), together with detailed clinical characterization of the patients who donated tumour specimens.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们介绍了 665 个人类癌症模型和 581 个肿瘤的生成和全面分子表征（其中 413 个模型产生了模型，168 个来自失败的衍生尝试），以及捐赠肿瘤标本的患者的详细临床表征。

sentences.en: Notably, such models maintained high concordance with the primary tumour with respect to DNA alterations (97.8%) and RNA expression (92%), despite being cultured for a year or longer ex vivo.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，尽管离体培养一年或更长时间，此类模型在 DNA 改变 (97.8%) 和 RNA 表达 (92%) 方面仍与原发肿瘤保持高度一致性。

sentences.en: This fact and the scale of the resource provide new opportunities for the scientific community to investigate the therapeutic consequences of a wide range of genetic alterations and transcriptional states.
sentences.zh: 这一事实和资源规模为科学界研究各种遗传改变和转录状态的治疗后果提供了新的机会。

sentences.en: For example, the two companion papers26,27 demonstrate that the HCMI models are indeed suitable for high-throughput characterization of genetic dependencies using genome-wide CRISPR–Cas9-based screens and systematic assessments of drug sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 例如，两篇配套论文26,27 证明 HCMI 模型确实适合使用基于全基因组 CRISPR-Cas9 的筛选和药物敏感性的系统评估来高通量表征遗传依赖性。

blocks.html_en: Cell lines and organoid cultures have important limitations, several of which are documented herein. Moreover, a growing body of literature34,53,54,55 indicates that components of tissue culture media are key drivers of cell-state plasticity in cancer models. For example, our demonstration that NSA medium maintains the transcriptional states of GBM tumours, whereas other media do not, are reminiscent of recent reports that describe a similar influence of growth medium on cell states of pancreatic cancer models34. Such cell-state plasticity can be reversible, which suggests that models that have transcriptionally shifted can be converted into a state that is more faithful to the tumour by changing ex vivo growth conditions before experimentation.

sentences.en: Cell lines and organoid cultures have important limitations, several of which are documented herein.
sentences.zh: 细胞系和类器官培养物具有重要的局限性，本文记录了其中的一些局限性。

sentences.en: Moreover, a growing body of literature34,53,54,55 indicates that components of tissue culture media are key drivers of cell-state plasticity in cancer models.
sentences.zh: 此外，越来越多的文献34,53,54,55表明组织培养基的成分是癌症模型中细胞状态可塑性的关键驱动因素。

sentences.en: For example, our demonstration that NSA medium maintains the transcriptional states of GBM tumours, whereas other media do not, are reminiscent of recent reports that describe a similar influence of growth medium on cell states of pancreatic cancer models34.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们证明 NSA 培养基维持 GBM 肿瘤的转录状态，而其他培养基则不然，这让人想起最近的报告，这些报告描述了生长培养基对胰腺癌模型细胞状态的类似影响34。

sentences.en: Such cell-state plasticity can be reversible, which suggests that models that have transcriptionally shifted can be converted into a state that is more faithful to the tumour by changing ex vivo growth conditions before experimentation.
sentences.zh: 这种细胞状态可塑性是可逆的，这表明通过在实验前改变离体生长条件，可以将转录转移的模型转化为更忠实于肿瘤的状态。

blocks.html_en: The HCMI models are well suited to the systematic, scalable discovery of new targets and mechanisms of cancer. However, the absence of stromal and immune cells in the HCMI models limits their applicability in the study of immune responses; other model formats will be needed to fill this gap. Despite this limitation, in a subset of 25 models derived from patients previously treated with immunotherapy, we examined features previously associated with resistance phenotypes. Although these models lack an immune microenvironment, they may serve as a resource for studying tumour-intrinsic mechanisms of resistance and for identifying alternative therapeutic strategies.

sentences.en: The HCMI models are well suited to the systematic, scalable discovery of new targets and mechanisms of cancer.
sentences.zh: HCMI 模型非常适合系统、可扩展地发现癌症的新靶点和机制。

sentences.en: However, the absence of stromal and immune cells in the HCMI models limits their applicability in the study of immune responses; other model formats will be needed to fill this gap.
sentences.zh: 然而，HCMI 模型中缺乏基质细胞和免疫细胞，限制了它们在免疫反应研究中的适用性。需要其他模型格式来填补这一空白。

sentences.en: Despite this limitation, in a subset of 25 models derived from patients previously treated with immunotherapy, we examined features previously associated with resistance phenotypes.
sentences.zh: 尽管存在这一限制，在源自先前接受免疫疗法治疗的患者的 25 个模型子集中，我们检查了先前与耐药表型相关的特征。

sentences.en: Although these models lack an immune microenvironment, they may serve as a resource for studying tumour-intrinsic mechanisms of resistance and for identifying alternative therapeutic strategies.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些模型缺乏免疫微环境，但它们可以作为研究肿瘤内在耐药机制和确定替代治疗策略的资源。

blocks.html_en: Although most models were highly concordant with their parental tumours, approximately 4–8% of models seemed to be less concordant. For 16 tumour–model pairs, we performed snRNA-seq to clarify mechanisms of discordance at the single-cell level. These data supported the existence of three distinct mechanisms: (1) purification, in which loss of stromal and immune infiltrates present in the parent tumour are typically absent in cancer models; (2) selection, in which there is selective evolutionary outgrowth of a minor cancer subclone from the primary tumour; and (3) epigenomic plasticity, in which a transcriptional shift alters the relative representation of malignant cell states in models compared with the tumour of origin (in some cases, this was due to the culture medium). Despite the epigenomic plasticity of the cell state of some models, most models retained some representation of each of the cell states found in the parental tumour. This result suggests that single-cell analysis of HCMI models could gauge the influence of the most defined cellular states in response to drugs and to other perturbations.

sentences.en: Although most models were highly concordant with their parental tumours, approximately 4–8% of models seemed to be less concordant.
sentences.zh: 尽管大多数模型与其亲本肿瘤高度一致，但大约 4-8% 的模型似乎不太一致。

sentences.en: For 16 tumour–model pairs, we performed snRNA-seq to clarify mechanisms of discordance at the single-cell level.
sentences.zh: 对于 16 个肿瘤模型对，我们进行了 snRNA-seq 以阐明单细胞水平上的不一致机制。

sentences.en: These data supported the existence of three distinct mechanisms: (1) purification, in which loss of stromal and immune infiltrates present in the parent tumour are typically absent in cancer models; (2) selection, in which there is selective evolutionary outgrowth of a minor cancer subclone from the primary tumour; and (3) epigenomic plasticity, in which a transcriptional shift alters the relative representation of malignant cell states in models compared with the tumour of origin (in some cases, this was due to the culture medium).
sentences.zh: 这些数据支持三种不同机制的存在：（1）纯化，其中母体肿瘤中存在的基质和免疫浸润的丧失在癌症模型中通常不存在； (2)选择，其中从原发肿瘤选择性进化出较小的癌症亚克隆； （3）表观基因组可塑性，其中转录转变改变了模型中恶性细胞状态与起源肿瘤相比的相对表征（在某些情况下，这是由于培养基造成的）。

sentences.en: Despite the epigenomic plasticity of the cell state of some models, most models retained some representation of each of the cell states found in the parental tumour.
sentences.zh: 尽管某些模型的细胞状态具有表观基因组可塑性，但大多数模型保留了亲本肿瘤中发现的每种细胞状态的一些表征。

sentences.en: This result suggests that single-cell analysis of HCMI models could gauge the influence of the most defined cellular states in response to drugs and to other perturbations.
sentences.zh: 这一结果表明，HCMI 模型的单细胞分析可以衡量最明确的细胞状态对药物和其他扰动的反应的影响。

blocks.html_en: Recent reports have highlighted the under-representation of publicly available cancer models of rare cancers, rare genotypes and cancers from ethnic and ancestry groups other than those of European origin56,57. We took specific steps to address those challenges. These efforts were partially successful; the HCMI includes 153 rare cancer models and 38 models from patients of recent African descent.

sentences.zh: 最近的报告强调了罕见癌症、罕见基因型以及来自欧洲以外的种族和血统群体的癌症的公开癌症模型代表性不足56,57。

blocks.html_en: However, we acknowledge that this diversity is insufficient and that further efforts are needed internationally to develop cancer models that avoid historical biases to ensure that research benefits all patients with cancer.

sentences.en: However, we acknowledge that this diversity is insufficient and that further efforts are needed internationally to develop cancer models that avoid historical biases to ensure that research benefits all patients with cancer.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们承认这种多样性是不够的，国际上需要进一步努力开发癌症模型，避免历史偏见，以确保研究惠及所有癌症患者。

blocks.html_en: With the inclusion of the CCLE cell-line resource, over 2,000 publicly available cancer models now exist in the public domain (https://cancermodels.org/). However, in a post-TCGA and International Cancer Genome Consortium (ICGC)4 era, we recognize the scale of diversity of tumour subtypes, genetic alterations and phenotypic states that dictate the prognosis and treatment response of patients with cancer. Thus, we consider that the HCMI effort is only the beginning. That is, an order of magnitude expansion in publicly available cancer models may be needed to fully capture the heterogeneity of human cancers and to power the future of drug discovery for all patients.

sentences.zh: 方法

blocks.html_en: Biospecimen processing and quality control

sentences.zh: 生物样本处理和质量控制

blocks.html_en: Before extracting nucleic acids, pathology quality control (QC) was performed on all frozen and FFPE tumours and normal specimens. From frozen tissue, a 30 mg or smaller piece was prepared, or an equivalent amount of scrolls were cut from a FFPE block, with sections stained with haematoxylin and eosin taken from the top and bottom of each specimen. The stained slides were scanned and their pathology reviewed to confirm that the tumour was consistent with the reported histology, and to assess the per cent tumour nuclei, per cent necrosis and other pathological features. The tumour nucleus and necrosis percentages from the top and bottom slides were averaged, and tumour specimens with an average of ≥50% tumour nuclei and ≤20% necrosis were submitted for nucleic acid extraction. Normal tissues were rejected if they had any detectable tumour cells.

sentences.en: Before extracting nucleic acids, pathology quality control (QC) was performed on all frozen and FFPE tumours and normal specimens.
sentences.zh: 在提取核酸之前，对所有冷冻和 FFPE 肿瘤以及正常标本进行病理质量控制 (QC)。

blocks.html_en: DNA was extracted from normal blood and saliva specimens. DNA and RNA were co-extracted from tumours, solid normal tissues and cancer models. Before extraction, cancer models were first washed with ice-cold PBS to remove residual Matrigel. Frozen tissues and cancer models were homogenized using a Qiagen TissueLyser, and RNA and DNA were extracted using a modification of the DNA/RNA AllPrep kit (Qiagen). The homogenate was applied to a Qiagen DNA column, and the flow-through was processed using a mirVana miRNA Isolation kit (Ambion). FFPE specimens were deparaffinized and cells were lysed. The pellet underwent DNA extraction using an AllPrep FFPE kit (Qiagen), whereas the supernatant underwent RNA extraction using a Highpure miRNA kit (Roche). Blood specimens were extracted using a QiaAmp DNA Blood Midi kit (Qiagen), and saliva was extracted using a Gentra Puregene Buccal Cell kit (Qiagen).

blocks.html_en: DNA was quantified by PicoGreen assay and RNA was quantified by measuring the absorbance at 260 nm with a UV spectrophotometer. DNA quality was assessed by 1% agarose gel electrophoresis to confirm high-molecular-weight fragments. RNA was analysed using a RNA6000 Nano assay (Agilent) on an Agilent Bioanalyzer, which returns an RNA integrity number (RIN) for RNA from frozen tissues, or a DV200 for RNA extracted from FFPE specimens. All extracted DNA was subjected to a custom Sequenom single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) panel or an AmpFISTR Identifiler (Applied Biosystems) to verify that all specimens representing a case were derived from the same patient.

blocks.html_en: Data processing

sentences.zh: 数据处理

blocks.html_en: The Genomics Data Commons (GDC) DNA-seq alignment pipeline59, was used to map WGS reads to a customized version of GRCh38. In brief, reads were aligned using BWA-MEM (v.0.7.15)60, followed by sorting, merging and duplicate-marking using Picard Tools (v2.26.10). Base quality scores were recalibrated using GATK (v.3.7.0)58 and BQSR. Sample contamination levels were estimated using GATK ContEst, and samples with contamination levels exceeding 4% were excluded from further analyses.

blocks.html_en: SNV and indel calling

sentences.zh: SNV 和 indel 调用

blocks.html_en: The New York Genome Center pipeline. The New York Genome Center (NYGC; v.6) somatic SNV–indel-calling pipeline61 was run for each tumour–normal and model–normal pair, starting from the GDC-aligned BAM files. In brief, SNVs, multi-nucleotide variants (MNVs) and indels were called using MuTect2 (GATK v.4.0.5.1)62, Strelka2 (v.2.9.3)63 and Lancet (v.1.0.7)64. Indels were also called using SvABA (v.0.2.12)65. Candidate indels predicted by Manta (v.1.4.0)66 were used as input to Strelka2, as per developer recommendations. Variants were merged across callers and annotated using Ensembl (v.93)67, COSMIC (v.86)47, 1000Genomes (Phase3)68, ClinVar (201706)69, PolyPhen (v.2.2.2)70, SIFT (v.5.2.2)71, FATHMM (v.2.1)72, gnomAD (r.2.0.1)73 and dbSNP (v.150)74, using Variant Effect Predictor (v.93.2)75. From the final callset of SNVs and indels, we filtered those that met the following criteria: occurred in two or more individuals in a panel of normal samples61; those that had a minor allele frequency (MAF) of at least 1% in 1000Genomes or in gnomAD; had a tumour VAF less than 0.0001; had a normal VAF greater than 0.2; had depth less than 2 in either the tumour or the normal sample; or a VAF in the normal sample greater than in the tumour sample. The aforementioned panel of normal samples was constructed from 242 unrelated individuals, of which 148 were sequenced using HiSeqX in the Illumina Polaris project76, 73 were sequenced using HiSeqX at the NYGC, 11 were sequenced using NovaSeq at the NYGC, and 10 were sequenced on both HiSeqX and NovaSeq platforms at NYGC.

blocks.html_en: Broad pipeline (whole-exome sequencing).Whole-exome sequencing (WES) BAM files were processed as described in the section ‘Data processing’. Tumour-in-normal contamination estimation was performed using deTiN, and cross-participant contamination was estimated using ContEst. WES variant calling was performed as previously described77. A similar pipeline was used for processing variant calls from WGS.

blocks.html_en: WashU pipeline. The somatic variant pipeline TinDaisy2 (v.2.6.2; https://github.com/ding-lab/TinDaisy) was built around the common workflow language and rooted in the methods of an earlier GenomeVIP pipeline architecture78. For both WGS and WES data, we used TinDaisy2 for calling both SNV and indel variants. In brief, aligned BAMs for tumour and normal samples were processed using VarScan (v.2.3.8)79, Strelka2 (v.2.9.10)63, Pindel80 and MuTect (v.mutect-1.1.7)81. Filtering was performed to retain calls with length < 100, normal VAF ≤ 0.02, tumour VAF ≥ 0.05, tumour read depth > 14 and normal read depth > 8. Only variants identified by at least two or more callers were retained. Following annotation using VEP 99 (ref. 82), calls with a population allele frequency of <0.005 were retained, and those that are in dbSnP but not in COSMIC47 or ClinVar83 were excluded. Adjacent SNP variants were merged into double nucleotide polymorphisms and higher-order variants, and the resulting VCF output was normalized with bcftools (v.1.10.2)84.

blocks.html_en: Consensus method. The workflow MergeParticipantVcfs was run for all participants in the cohort. First, single-pair VCFs and MAFs from the NYGC (v.6) somatic pipeline, the Broad somatic pipeline and the WashU somatic pipeline were prepared for merging with the MergeVcf workflow. Multi-allelic calls were split, MNVs were labelled and then split into SNVs, centre names were prepended to all annotations and indels were left-aligned and normalized. Prepared VCFs were merged using BCFTools84. During the merge–normalization of variants, the merging of SNPs into indels was not allowed. We calculated allele depth, read depth and allele frequency from BAM pileups using a custom method as described previously desribed61. MNVs were re-established. If a pipeline reported only a subset of the SNVs that constitute an MNV, then the SNVs were also reported as a possible variant.

All ABSOLUTE calls were manually curated to identify the ABSOLUTE with integer copy number states best aligning with the observed copy number values. In samples with no CNAs, the optimal ABSOLUTE solution was inferred from SNV multiplicity.

blocks.html_en: PURPLE method. For each tumour–normal or model–normal sample pair, we generated a B-allele frequency of heterozygous SNP sites using AMBER (v.3.5)88, and we determined read depth ratios using COBALT (v.1.11)88. We integrated this information, together with somatic SNVs and structural variants (SVs) to estimate the purity, ploidy and copy number profile of the tumour using PURPLE (v.2.54)88. Tumour and model samples that did not have a matched normal sample were processed in a similar manner, but with several version changes: AMBER (v.3.9), COBALT (v.1.13) and PURPLE (v.3.4). AMBER, COBALT and PURPLE were developed by the Hartwig Medical Foundation and are freely available on GitHub (https://github.com/hartwigmedical/hmftools).

blocks.html_en: HATCHet method. For each tumour–normal or model–normal sample pair, we ran HATCHet-2 (ref. 89) and estimated purity and ploidy. We used default parameters, but with the following exceptions. The minimum and maximum number of states and state transition probability in the hidden Markov model were set to 20, 40 and 10−12, respectively, whereas ‘diploidbaf’ and ‘maxneutralshift’ parameters were both set to 0.06. The search space for the number of clones was between two and four. A Gurobi commercial optimizer was used as the preferred engine for solving integer linear programming.

sentences.zh: SV 呼叫

blocks.html_en: NYGC pipeline. The NYGC (v.6) somatic SV-calling pipeline61 was run for each tumour–normal and model–normal pair, starting from the GDC-aligned BAM files. In brief, SV breakpoints were called using SvABA (v.0.2.12)65, Manta (v.1.4.0)66 and Lumpy (v.0.2.13)90. We excluded SVs below 500 bp, merged the rest across callers using bedtools (v.2.26.0)91, pair-to-pair with the slop parameter set to 300 bp, and requiring the same strand orientation and at least 50% reciprocal overlap. SVs were annotated using 1000Genomes (Phase3)68, DGV92, gnomAD-SV93 and the SV panel of normals (built from the same individuals as the NYGC SNV–indel pipeline) with bedtools pair-to-pair, using the same parameters as for the merge across callers. We removed from the final callset any SVs that overlapped variants in 1000Genomes, DGV, gnomAD-SV or the panel of normals.

blocks.html_en: Broad pipeline. SVs were called using Manta66, SvABA65 and dRanger94. Breakpointer94 was used to refine breakpoint locations of called variants. The same SV had to have been called across at least two of Manta, SvABA and dRanger (using a clustering window of 350 bp to match the SV to the same event) to show up in the final callset. Certain filters were applied across various steps of the pipeline based on span, mapping quality and reads of support for SV events.

blocks.html_en: WashU pipeline. We used Manta (v.1.6.0)66 for calling SVs on matched tumour–normal WGS data. We then filtered results to retain variants that met the following criteria: (1) the sample site depth was less than 3× the median chromosome depth near one or both variant breakends; (2) the somatic score was greater than 30; and (3) for a small variant (<1,000 bases) in the normal sample, the fraction of reads with MAPQ0 around the breakend did not exceed 0.4. We then converted VCF files to BEDPE format with svtools (v.0.5.1)95 (https://github.com/hall-lab/svtools).

sentences.en: We then converted VCF files to BEDPE format with svtools (v.0.5.1)95 (https://github.com/hall-lab/svtools).
sentences.zh: 然后，我们使用 svtools (v.0.5.1)95 (https://github.com/hall-lab/svtools) 将 VCF 文件转换为 BEDPE 格式。

blocks.html_en: MSKCC pipeline. We identified SVs using deStruct (v.0.4.18)96 and LUMPY (v.0.2.12)90, retaining only the breakpoints called by both methods. We applied filtering based on the following criteria: inter-breakpoint distances of ≤30 bp; deletions smaller than 1,000 bp; breakpoints with fewer than 5 supporting reads in the tumour sample; or any read support in the matched normal sample.

sentences.zh: MSKCC 管道。

sentences.en: We identified SVs using deStruct (v.0.4.18)96 and LUMPY (v.0.2.12)90, retaining only the breakpoints called by both methods.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 deStruct (v.0.4.18)96 和 LUMPY (v.0.2.12)90 识别 SV，仅保留这两种方法调用的断点。

sentences.en: We applied filtering based on the following criteria: inter-breakpoint distances of ≤30 bp; deletions smaller than 1,000 bp; breakpoints with fewer than 5 supporting reads in the tumour sample; or any read support in the matched normal sample.
sentences.zh: 我们根据以下标准应用过滤：断点间距离≤30 bp；缺失小于 1,000 bp；肿瘤样本中支持读数少于 5 个的断点；或匹配的正常样本中的任何读取支持。

blocks.html_en: EMBL-EBI pipeline. For tumour–normal and model–normal sample pairs, somatic SVs were called using GRIDSS2 (v.2.12.0)97, annotated with RepeatMasker (v.4.1.2)98, and kraken2 (v.2.1.2)99 and filtered with GRIPSS (v.1.9)100. The final somatic SV set was further refined and annotated with the copy number profile estimated using PURPLE (v.2.54)88. SVs and copy number profiles were visualized using the ReConPlot R package (v.1.0)101. Tumour and model samples without a matched normal sample were processed in a similar manner but with several version changes: GRIPSS (v.2.0.1) and PURPLE (v.3.4).

sentences.zh: EMBL-EBI 管道。

sentences.en: For tumour–normal and model–normal sample pairs, somatic SVs were called using GRIDSS2 (v.2.12.0)97, annotated with RepeatMasker (v.4.1.2)98, and kraken2 (v.2.1.2)99 and filtered with GRIPSS (v.1.9)100.
sentences.zh: 对于肿瘤-正常和模型-正常样本对，使用 GRIDSS2 (v.2.12.0)97 调用体细胞 SV，用 RepeatMasker (v.4.1.2)98 和 kraken2 (v.2.1.2)99 注释，并用 GRIPSS (v.1.9)100 过滤。

sentences.en: The final somatic SV set was further refined and annotated with the copy number profile estimated using PURPLE (v.2.54)88.
sentences.zh: 最终的体细胞 SV 集进一步细化并用使用 PURPLE (v.2.54)88 估计的拷贝数图谱进行注释。

sentences.en: SVs and copy number profiles were visualized using the ReConPlot R package (v.1.0)101.
sentences.zh: 使用 ReConPlot R 软件包 (v.1.0)101 可视化 SV 和拷贝数概况。

sentences.en: Tumour and model samples without a matched normal sample were processed in a similar manner but with several version changes: GRIPSS (v.2.0.1) and PURPLE (v.3.4).
sentences.zh: 没有匹配正常样本的肿瘤和模型样本以类似的方式处理，但有几个版本更改：GRIPSS (v.2.0.1) 和 PURPLE (v.3.4)。

blocks.html_en: Consensus method. Consensus SVs from the NYGC Broad, WashU, MSKCC and EMBL-EBI were identified as previously described102 using bedtools pair2pair with minor modifications. The original consensus algorithm used single-caller VCFs as inputs, whereas the modified pipeline uses multicaller consensus inputs from each centre. Moreover, the original pipeline used a slop value of 400, whereas the modified pipeline uses a slop value of 50. SVs called by pipelines from two or more analysis centres were accepted into the final SV consensus.

sentences.zh: 共识法。

sentences.en: Consensus SVs from the NYGC Broad, WashU, MSKCC and EMBL-EBI were identified as previously described102 using bedtools pair2pair with minor modifications.
sentences.zh: 来自 NYGC Broad、WashU、MSKCC 和 EMBL-EBI 的共识 SV 是按照之前描述的 102 使用 Bedtoolspair2pair 进行微小修改来识别的。

sentences.en: The original consensus algorithm used single-caller VCFs as inputs, whereas the modified pipeline uses multicaller consensus inputs from each centre.
sentences.zh: 原始共识算法使用单调用者 VCF 作为输入，而修改后的管道使用来自每个中心的多调用者共识输入。

sentences.en: Moreover, the original pipeline used a slop value of 400, whereas the modified pipeline uses a slop value of 50.
sentences.zh: 此外，原始管道使用的斜率值为 400，而修改后的管道使用的斜率值为 50。

sentences.en: SVs called by pipelines from two or more analysis centres were accepted into the final SV consensus.
sentences.zh: 来自两个或多个分析中心的管道调用的 SV 被接受到最终的 SV 共识中。

blocks.html_en: Purity and ploidy

sentences.zh: 纯度和倍性

blocks.html_en: ESTIMATE. Tumour purity was computed according to the ESTIMATE algorithm103, which generates a composite ESTIMATE score that represents the quantification of predefined gene signatures of non-tumour components (stromal and immune) in gene expression data. Tumour purity was then inferred using the following formula: tumour purity = cos (0.6049872018 + 0.0001467884 × ESTIMATE score).

sentences.zh: 估计。

sentences.en: Tumour purity was computed according to the ESTIMATE algorithm103, which generates a composite ESTIMATE score that represents the quantification of predefined gene signatures of non-tumour components (stromal and immune) in gene expression data.
sentences.zh: 肿瘤纯度是根据估计算法103计算的，该算法生成一个综合估计分数，代表基因表达数据中非肿瘤成分（基质和免疫）的预定义基因特征的量化。

sentences.en: Tumour purity was then inferred using the following formula: tumour purity = cos (0.6049872018 + 0.0001467884 × ESTIMATE score).
sentences.zh: 然后使用以下公式推断肿瘤纯度：肿瘤纯度= cos (0.6049872018 + 0.0001467884 × 估计分数)。

blocks.html_en: Consensus purity and ploidy. We computed consensus tumour and model purity and ploidy from the purity and ploidy values from five DNA-based copy number callers (Ascat, ABSOLUTE, ReMixT, PURPLE and Hatchet) and purity values from a sixth RNA-based caller (ESTIMATE). Consensus purity was computed using an iterative process wherein the mean purity across all callers was first computed. If the individual purity values across all six purity callers fell within ±0.2 of the mean purity, then the mean purity was accepted as the consensus purity. If one or more callers fell outside the window, then the furthest caller from the mean was removed and the mean ploidy was recomputed. This process was repeated until all remaining callers converged on a consensus purity value or when fewer than three callers remained. In the latter case, the purity value was accepted as the value from ABSOLUTE or, in cases when there was no ABSOLUTE value, from PURPLE.

sentences.zh: 共识纯度和倍性。

sentences.en: We computed consensus tumour and model purity and ploidy from the purity and ploidy values from five DNA-based copy number callers (Ascat, ABSOLUTE, ReMixT, PURPLE and Hatchet) and purity values from a sixth RNA-based caller (ESTIMATE).
sentences.zh: 我们根据来自五个基于 DNA 的拷贝数调用者（Ascat、ABSOLUTE、ReMixT、PURPLE 和 Hatchet）的纯度和倍性值以及来自第六个基于 RNA 的调用者的纯度值（估计）计算了一致的肿瘤和模型纯度和倍性。

sentences.en: Consensus purity was computed using an iterative process wherein the mean purity across all callers was first computed.
sentences.zh: 使用迭代过程计算共识纯度，其中首先计算所有调用者的平均纯度。

sentences.en: If the individual purity values across all six purity callers fell within ±0.2 of the mean purity, then the mean purity was accepted as the consensus purity.
sentences.zh: 如果所有六个纯度调用者的个体纯度值落在平均纯度的 ±0.2 范围内，则平均纯度被接受为共识纯度。

sentences.en: If one or more callers fell outside the window, then the furthest caller from the mean was removed and the mean ploidy was recomputed.
sentences.zh: 如果一个或多个呼叫者落在窗口之外，则距离平均值最远的呼叫者将被删除，并重新计算平均倍性。

sentences.en: This process was repeated until all remaining callers converged on a consensus purity value or when fewer than three callers remained.
sentences.zh: 重复此过程，直到所有剩余的调用者都收敛到一致的纯度值，或者剩下的调用者少于三个。

sentences.en: In the latter case, the purity value was accepted as the value from ABSOLUTE or, in cases when there was no ABSOLUTE value, from PURPLE.
sentences.zh: 在后一种情况下，纯度值被接受为来自 ABSOLUTE 的值，或者在没有 ABSOLUTE 值的情况下，来自 PURPLE 的值。

blocks.html_en: Ploidy values for each individual caller were first binned into ploidy classes: haploid (ploidy < 1.5), diploid (1.5 ≤ ploidy < 2.5), triploid (2.5 ≤ ploidy < 3.5) or tetraploid (≥3.5). If values from three or more callers fell in the same ploidy class, then the median ploidy from all callers in that ploidy class was taken as the consensus ploidy. If there was no agreement between three or more callers, then the ploidy value from ABSOLUTE was accepted as the consensus ploidy value or, in cases when there was no ABSOLUTE value, the value from PURPLE was accepted as the consensus ploidy value. All consensus purity and ploidy values went through subsequent manual curation and the ABSOLUTE solution was selected in cases when the consensus purity and ploidy values poorly reflected the underlying copy number states.

sentences.en: Ploidy values for each individual caller were first binned into ploidy classes: haploid (ploidy < 1.5), diploid (1.5 ≤ ploidy < 2.5), triploid (2.5 ≤ ploidy < 3.5) or tetraploid (≥3.5).
sentences.zh: 每个呼叫者的倍性值首先被分为倍性类别：单倍体（倍性 < 1.5）、二倍体（1.5 ≤ 倍性 < 2.5）、三倍体（2.5 ≤ 倍性 < 3.5）或四倍体（≥ 3.5）。

sentences.en: If values from three or more callers fell in the same ploidy class, then the median ploidy from all callers in that ploidy class was taken as the consensus ploidy.
sentences.zh: 如果来自三个或更多呼叫者的值属于同一倍性类别，则该倍性类别中所有呼叫者的中值倍性被视为一致倍性。

sentences.en: If there was no agreement between three or more callers, then the ploidy value from ABSOLUTE was accepted as the consensus ploidy value or, in cases when there was no ABSOLUTE value, the value from PURPLE was accepted as the consensus ploidy value.
sentences.zh: 如果三个或更多调用者之间没有达成一致，则来自 ABSOLUTE 的倍性值被接受为共识倍性值，或者，在没有 ABSOLUTE 值的情况下，来自 PURPLE 的值被接受为共识倍性值。

sentences.en: All consensus purity and ploidy values went through subsequent manual curation and the ABSOLUTE solution was selected in cases when the consensus purity and ploidy values poorly reflected the underlying copy number states.
sentences.zh: 所有共有纯度和倍性值均经过后续手动管理，并且在共有纯度和倍性值不能很好地反映基础拷贝数状态的情况下选择绝对解决方案。

blocks.html_en: Analysis methods

sentences.zh: 分析方法

blocks.html_en: Tumour–model SNV concordance. SNVs included in concordance analysis were filtered for variants with VAF > 0.15 or variants for which all non-normal aliquots contained read support.

sentences.zh: 肿瘤模型 SNV 一致性。

sentences.en: SNVs included in concordance analysis were filtered for variants with VAF > 0.15 or variants for which all non-normal aliquots contained read support.
sentences.zh: 一致性分析中包含的 SNV 被过滤，以查找 VAF > 0.15 的变体或所有非正常等分试样都包含读数支持的变体。

blocks.html_en: Tumour–model LOH concordance. The LOH status for all tumour–model pairs was determined by examining whether the rounded minor copy number of each genomic bin was equal to zero. LOH status was then compared between the tumour and its corresponding model, assigning a value of 1 for concordance and 0 for discordance. The mean LOH concordance was subsequently calculated across all equal-sized bins, which provided a single LOH concordance value for each tumour–model pair.

sentences.zh: 肿瘤模型 LOH 一致性。

sentences.en: The LOH status for all tumour–model pairs was determined by examining whether the rounded minor copy number of each genomic bin was equal to zero.
sentences.zh: 所有肿瘤模型对的 LOH 状态是通过检查每个基因组箱的四舍五入的次要拷贝数是否等于 0 来确定的。

sentences.en: LOH status was then compared between the tumour and its corresponding model, assigning a value of 1 for concordance and 0 for discordance.
sentences.zh: 然后比较肿瘤与其相应模型之间的 LOH 状态，将一致性指定为 1，将不一致指定为 0。

sentences.en: The mean LOH concordance was subsequently calculated across all equal-sized bins, which provided a single LOH concordance value for each tumour–model pair.
sentences.zh: 随后计算所有相同大小的 bin 的平均 LOH 一致性，这为每个肿瘤模型对提供了单个 LOH 一致性值。

blocks.html_en: WGD inference. We determined WGD status by assessing genome-wide CNAs. First, we calculated the fraction of the genome that was affected by copy number gains, weighting each segment by its genomic length. We evaluated the extent of duplication based on thresholds for copy number amplification across the genome. Samples in which a majority of the genome exhibited copy number gains beyond a defined threshold were classified as having undergone a single WGD event, whereas those surpassing a higher threshold were assigned multiple WGD events.

sentences.zh: WGD 推断。

sentences.en: We determined WGD status by assessing genome-wide CNAs.
sentences.zh: 我们通过评估全基因组 CNA 来确定 WGD 状态。

sentences.en: First, we calculated the fraction of the genome that was affected by copy number gains, weighting each segment by its genomic length.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们计算了受拷贝数增加影响的基因组部分，并根据基因组长度对每个片段进行加权。

sentences.en: We evaluated the extent of duplication based on thresholds for copy number amplification across the genome.
sentences.zh: 我们根据整个基因组拷贝数扩增的阈值评估了重复的程度。

sentences.en: Samples in which a majority of the genome exhibited copy number gains beyond a defined threshold were classified as having undergone a single WGD event, whereas those surpassing a higher threshold were assigned multiple WGD events.
sentences.zh: 大多数基因组表现出超出定义阈值的拷贝数增益的样本被归类为经历了单个 WGD 事件，而超过较高阈值的样本则被分配为多个 WGD 事件。

blocks.html_en: Mutation signature. SNV mutational signatures were computed using SignatureAnalyzer (GPU version)104,105 with the COSMIC single-base substitution signature reference comprising 96 mutational signatures. During mutational signature factorization, a set of 51 non-redundant mutational signatures were selected. For each tumour and matched model, we generated per-sample mutational signature profiles represented as exposure vectors across these 51 signatures. Concordance between tumours and their matched models (n = 440 pairs) was quantified in terms of the cosine similarity between their respective signature profiles. As a negative control, we generated random tumour–model pairings of equal number, both in the same tumour type and across different tumour types, and calculated cosine similarities for the randomized pairs.

sentences.zh: 突变签名。

sentences.en: SNV mutational signatures were computed using SignatureAnalyzer (GPU version)104,105 with the COSMIC single-base substitution signature reference comprising 96 mutational signatures.
sentences.zh: 使用 SignatureAnalyzer（GPU 版本）104,105 和包含 96 个突变签名的 COSMIC 单碱基替换签名参考来计算 SNV 突变签名。

sentences.en: During mutational signature factorization, a set of 51 non-redundant mutational signatures were selected.
sentences.zh: 在突变特征分解过程中，选择了一组 51 个非冗余突变特征。

sentences.en: For each tumour and matched model, we generated per-sample mutational signature profiles represented as exposure vectors across these 51 signatures.
sentences.zh: 对于每个肿瘤和匹配的模型，我们生成了每个样本的突变特征谱，表示为这 51 个特征的暴露向量。

sentences.en: Concordance between tumours and their matched models (n = 440 pairs) was quantified in terms of the cosine similarity between their respective signature profiles.
sentences.zh: 肿瘤与其匹配模型（n = 440 对）之间的一致性根据其各自特征谱之间的余弦相似性进行量化。

sentences.en: As a negative control, we generated random tumour–model pairings of equal number, both in the same tumour type and across different tumour types, and calculated cosine similarities for the randomized pairs.
sentences.zh: 作为阴性对照，我们在相同肿瘤类型和不同肿瘤类型中生成相同数量的随机肿瘤模型配对，并计算随机对的余弦相似度。

blocks.html_en: Driver oncogene selection and classification. To assess the differences in the prevalence of driver mutations between tumour and model samples, we first curated a set of driver genes based on previous TCGA studies106 (Supplementary Table 10). To determine the prevalence of SNVs, small indels and copy number variations (CNVs), we integrated the results from both SNV–indel and copy number analyses. Gene annotations for SNVs and indels were obtained through the discovery pipeline. Only mutations with a predicted impact of moderate or high, as defined in the Ensembl calculated gene consequences table, were included in downstream analyses. An additional mutation category included upstream promoter missense mutations in the TERT gene. Gene-level CNVs were annotated by calculating the mean copy number across the genomic span of each gene. Only genes with high-level amplifications or homozygous deletions were included in the downstream analysis. A gene was classified as highly amplified if it met the following criteria: (1) sample ploidy ≥ 1.5; (2) either the gene copy number was ≥3 and ≥2 times the ploidy (adjusted by –0.5 if the sample was a model); or (3) the gene copy number was ≥7. Conversely, a gene was classified as having a homozygous deletion if its copy number was below 0.3.

sentences.zh: 驱动癌基因的选择和分类。

sentences.en: To assess the differences in the prevalence of driver mutations between tumour and model samples, we first curated a set of driver genes based on previous TCGA studies106 (Supplementary Table 10).
sentences.zh: 为了评估肿瘤样本和模型样本之间驱动突变发生率的差异，我们首先根据之前的 TCGA 研究106（补充表 10）策划了一组驱动基因。

sentences.en: To determine the prevalence of SNVs, small indels and copy number variations (CNVs), we integrated the results from both SNV–indel and copy number analyses.
sentences.zh: 为了确定 SNV、小插入缺失和拷贝数变异 (CNV) 的发生率，我们整合了 SNV-插入缺失和拷贝数分析的结果。

sentences.en: Gene annotations for SNVs and indels were obtained through the discovery pipeline.
sentences.zh: SNV 和插入缺失的基因注释是通过发现管道获得的。

sentences.en: Only mutations with a predicted impact of moderate or high, as defined in the Ensembl calculated gene consequences table, were included in downstream analyses.
sentences.zh: 只有预测影响为中度或高度的突变（如 Ensembl 计算的基因后果表中所定义）才包含在下游分析中。

sentences.en: An additional mutation category included upstream promoter missense mutations in the TERT gene.
sentences.zh: 另一个突变类别包括 TERT 基因的上游启动子错义突变。

sentences.en: Gene-level CNVs were annotated by calculating the mean copy number across the genomic span of each gene.
sentences.zh: 通过计算每个基因的基因组跨度的平均拷贝数来注释基因水平的 CNV。

sentences.en: Only genes with high-level amplifications or homozygous deletions were included in the downstream analysis.
sentences.zh: 只有具有高水平扩增或纯合缺失的基因才包含在下游分析中。

sentences.en: A gene was classified as highly amplified if it met the following criteria: (1) sample ploidy ≥ 1.5; (2) either the gene copy number was ≥3 and ≥2 times the ploidy (adjusted by –0.5 if the sample was a model); or (3) the gene copy number was ≥7.
sentences.zh: 如果一个基因满足以下标准，则被归类为高度扩增：（1）样本倍性≥1.5； (2) 基因拷贝数≥3倍且≥2倍倍数（如果样本是模型，则调整–0.5）； (3)基因拷贝数≥7。

sentences.en: Conversely, a gene was classified as having a homozygous deletion if its copy number was below 0.3.
sentences.zh: 相反，如果基因的拷贝数低于 0.3，则该基因被归类为具有纯合缺失。

blocks.html_en: For the final visualization in Fig. 2, mutations were classified as either gain-of-function (GOF) or loss-of-function (LOF). For each gene, only mutations that were found in both tumour and matched model samples (that is, shared in a tumour-model pair) were considered. Only mutations shared between tumour and matched model samples (that is, present in both) were considered for classification. If no shared mutations were identified for a given gene, it was labelled as unclassified. Mutation types were grouped as follows: LOF included homozygous deletions, truncating variants (frameshift indels, nonsense and splice-site mutations); GOF included missense mutations, high-level amplifications, TERT promoter mutations and in-frame insertions or deletions. A gene was labelled LOF if more than 15% of its shared mutations were LOF events, otherwise, it was labelled as GOF.

sentences.en: For the final visualization in Fig. 2, mutations were classified as either gain-of-function (GOF) or loss-of-function (LOF).
sentences.zh: 对于图 2 中的最终可视化，突变被分类为功能获得 (GOF) 或功能丧失 (LOF)。

sentences.en: For each gene, only mutations that were found in both tumour and matched model samples (that is, shared in a tumour-model pair) were considered.
sentences.zh: 对于每个基因，仅考虑在肿瘤和匹配模型样本（即在肿瘤模型对中共享）中发现的突变。

sentences.en: Only mutations shared between tumour and matched model samples (that is, present in both) were considered for classification.
sentences.zh: 仅考虑肿瘤样本和匹配模型样本之间共享的突变（即两者都存在）进行分类。

sentences.en: If no shared mutations were identified for a given gene, it was labelled as unclassified.
sentences.zh: 如果给定基因没有发现共有突变，则将其标记为未分类。

sentences.en: Mutation types were grouped as follows: LOF included homozygous deletions, truncating variants (frameshift indels, nonsense and splice-site mutations); GOF included missense mutations, high-level amplifications, TERT promoter mutations and in-frame insertions or deletions.
sentences.zh: 突变类型分组如下：LOF包括纯合缺失、截短变异（移码插入缺失、无义突变和剪接位点突变）； GOF 包括错义突变、高水平扩增、TERT 启动子突变和框内插入或缺失。

sentences.en: A gene was labelled LOF if more than 15% of its shared mutations were LOF events, otherwise, it was labelled as GOF.
sentences.zh: 如果一个基因超过 15% 的共享突变是 LOF 事件，则该基因被标记为 LOF，否则，它被标记为 GOF。

blocks.html_en: Power calculation. We calculated a measure of the power to detect model SNVs in a given tumour by considering the probability that model SNVs would be detected in the tumour, assuming that there were clonal and at one allelic copy. The expected VAF for a single-allelic clonal tumour mutation at a genomic position with tumour copy number T is given by

sentences.zh: 功率计算。

sentences.en: We calculated a measure of the power to detect model SNVs in a given tumour by considering the probability that model SNVs would be detected in the tumour, assuming that there were clonal and at one allelic copy.
sentences.zh: 我们通过考虑在肿瘤中检测到模型 SNV 的概率（假设存在克隆且至少有一个等位基因拷贝），计算了在给定肿瘤中检测模型 SNV 的能力的度量。

sentences.en: The expected VAF for a single-allelic clonal tumour mutation at a genomic position with tumour copy number T is given by
sentences.zh: 肿瘤拷贝数为 T 的基因组位置处的单等位基因克隆肿瘤突变的预期 VAF 由下式给出

blocks.html_en: $$\mathrm{VAF}=\frac{\rho }{\rho T+(1-\rho )N}$$

Here N is the copy number at the given position of the contaminating cells, which was assumed to be two for autosomes. Then, assuming a binomial distribution of read counts and one read necessary to detect, the average power to detect a clonal SNV was calculated by

sentences.en: Here N is the copy number at the given position of the contaminating cells, which was assumed to be two for autosomes.

blocks.html_en: Clonal phylogenies. Force-called SNVs were input into pyclone and phyclone to generate clonal phylogenies. We excluded indels from the analysis. We annotated each SNV with the major and minor allele copy number of the encompassing segment from consensus copy number calling. SNV copy number and supporting read counts were input to pyclone-vi (v.0.1.6)121, which we ran with a beta-binomial observation model, 10 restarts and a maximum of 40 clusters. We removed clusters comprising less than 1% of all SNVs and clusters that were approximately 0.5 cancer cell fraction across all samples (cancer cell fraction range of 0.3–0.7). The resulting pyclone clusters were input to phyclone (v.0.5.1)122, which we ran with a beta-binomial observation model, 16 chains, 100,000 iterations and outlier probability set to 0.1.

blocks.html_en: Genetic ancestry estimation. Ancestry proportion was determined using ADMIXTURE (v.1.3.0)123,124, which used a maximum likelihood-based method to estimate the proportion of reference-population ancestries in a sample. To do this, we genotyped reference markers that we generated from 1,964 unrelated 1000Genomes project samples directly on the whole-genome samples using GATK pileup (v.3.4.0). We excluded individuals from the populations MXL (Mexican ancestry from Los Angeles, United States), ACB (African Caribbean in Barbados) and ASW (African ancestry in the Southwest United States) from the reference owing to their being putatively admixed. We further filtered the reference by using only SNP markers with a minimum MAF of 0.01 overall and 0.05 in at least one 1000Genomes continental population. Variants were also pruned on the basis of linkage disequilibrium using PLINK (v.1.9) with a window size of 500 kb, a step size of 250 kb and an r2 threshold of 0.2. The analysis resulted in a proportional breakdown of each sample into five continental populations (AFR, AMR, EAS, EUR and SAS) and 23 populations. We then categorized patients by the continental population of highest proportion.

blocks.html_en: We used normal tissue DNA methylation data from external resources to investigate cancer-associated DNA methylation profiles. We had previously identified 146,385 CpGs that were unmethylated in eight normal tissue types (breast, adrenal gland, liver, lung, ovary, skin, blood and brain) on the EPICv1 array126. We processed additional ENCODE normal tissue DNA methylation data from 23 normal tissue samples from the gastrointestinal tract, including oesophagus (muscularis mucosa n = 4, squamous epithelium n = 4), stomach (n = 3), colon (transverse n = 4, sigmoid n = 4) and pancreas (n = 4). We downloaded the EPICv1 IDAT files from the ENCODE data portal127 and generated β values using the openSesame pipeline, as described above. We identified 159,361 CpGs that had a mean β value of <0.2 in any of the four gastrointestinal tissue types. Collectively, we selected 144,571 CpGs unmethylated in normal tissues from 12 tissue types to investigate cancer-associated DNA hypermethylation profiles (Supplementary Table 11).

blocks.html_en: We merged the HCMI and TCGA–TARGET DNA methylation data profiled using EPICv1 and HM450 arrays, respectively, to generate a dataset with the probes shared between the two platforms125. We excluded samples that had a CpG probe success rate of less than 90%. We also excluded probes with ‘NA’-masked data points that were present in more than 10% of the samples and probes on the X and Y chromosomes. To investigate the cancer-associated DNA hypermethylation profiles, we analysed the probe set that lacked tissue-specific DNA methylation (selected as described above) and then extracted 53,204 CpG sites that acquired methylation (β value of >0.3) in at least two samples in any HCMI cancer type (Supplementary Table 11).

blocks.html_en: UMAP of DNA methylation data

sentences.zh: DNA甲基化数据的UMAP

blocks.html_en: We performed dimension reduction using NMF on the combined HCMI and TCGA–TARGET DNA methylation data matrix described above. β Values of 0 were replaced with 1.0 × 10−12, and missing values were replaced with zeros. The resulting matrix was subjected to NMF, masking zeros, as implemented in the RcppML R package (v.0.5.6)130. We assessed the optimal rank for an NMF model by performing matrix decomposition across ranks ranging from 2 to 200, each with three random initializations, using the crossValidate function in the RcppML R package. We selected an NMF model of rank 170, as this model showed the minimum mean squared error of reconstruction consistently across the three runs. UMAP visualization of the rank-170 NMF model was generated using the umap function with the cosine distance metric implemented in the R package umap (v.0.2.10.0) (Supplementary Table 11). We produced the UMAP in Fig. 4c using the subset of the rank-170 NMF matrix, which included the cancer types represented in both the HCMI and the TCGA–TARGET projects.

sentences.en: We performed dimension reduction using NMF on the combined HCMI and TCGA–TARGET DNA methylation data matrix described above. β Values of 0 were replaced with 1.0 × 10−12, and missing values were replaced with zeros.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 NMF 对上述组合的 HCMI 和 TCGA-TARGET DNA 甲基化数据矩阵进行降维。 β 值 0 替换为 1.0 × 10−12，缺失值替换为 0。

sentences.en: The resulting matrix was subjected to NMF, masking zeros, as implemented in the RcppML R package (v.0.5.6)130.
sentences.zh: 生成的矩阵经过 NMF，屏蔽零，如 RcppML R 包 (v.0.5.6)130 中实现的那样。

sentences.en: We assessed the optimal rank for an NMF model by performing matrix decomposition across ranks ranging from 2 to 200, each with three random initializations, using the crossValidate function in the RcppML R package.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 RcppML R 包中的 crossValidate 函数，通过在 2 到 200 的等级之间执行矩阵分解来评估 NMF 模型的最佳等级，每个等级具有三个随机初始化。

sentences.zh: 我们选择了等级 170 的 NMF 模型，因为该模型在三次运行中一致地显示了重建的最小均方误差。

sentences.en: UMAP visualization of the rank-170 NMF model was generated using the umap function with the cosine distance metric implemented in the R package umap (v.0.2.10.0) (Supplementary Table 11).
sentences.zh: Rank-170 NMF 模型的 UMAP 可视化是使用 umap 函数和 R 包 umap (v.0.2.10.0) 中实现的余弦距离度量生成的（补充表 11）。

sentences.zh: 我们使用排名 170 NMF 矩阵的子集生成了图 4c 中的 UMAP，其中包括 HCMI 和 TCGA-TARGET 项目中代表的癌症类型。

blocks.html_en: Heatmap of DNA methylation profiles

sentences.zh: DNA 甲基化谱热图

blocks.html_en: For the four cancer cohorts on which we focused, and from the HCMI–TCGA merged DNA methylation data described above, we identified the top 10% of the most variably methylated CpGs separately in each cancer type (Fig. 4e). We selected the 8,614 CpGs that represented the union of the 4 variably methylated CpG sets. To minimize the influence of variable tumour purity levels on clustering results, we dichotomized the data, using a β value of ≥0.3 to define positive DNA methylation and <0.3 to define a lack of methylation. The sample distance matrix was computed using the Jaccard index, and then unsupervised hierarchical clustering was performed for each TMP cancer subtype. We generated the heatmap using the ComplexHeatmap R package (v.2.20.0)131.

blocks.html_en: Tumour–model hypermethylation similarity scores

sentences.zh: 肿瘤模型高甲基化相似性评分

blocks.html_en: We assessed DNA methylation-based similarity between a model and its parent tumour based on cancer-associated CpG hypermethylation profiles. We identified the 144,571 CpGs unmethylated in normal tissues as described above. For each HCMI cancer type, we further selected CpGs hypermethylated (β value of >0.3) in at least two samples. Then we compared the Pearson’s correlation coefficient (r) as a similarity score for the following samples: (1) models and their matched tumours; (2) models and unmatched tumours from the same cancer type; and (3) models and unmatched tumours from different cancer types. A P value of paired model–tumour relatedness was then determined by calculating the probability of observing an unpaired model–tumour distance equal to or smaller than the same model’s distance to all unrelated tumours that were not from the same tissue type. After FDR adjustment, model–tumour pairs with adjusted P ≥ 0.1 were considered to be models that were non-concordant with their original tumours.

sentences.en: We assessed DNA methylation-based similarity between a model and its parent tumour based on cancer-associated CpG hypermethylation profiles.
sentences.zh: 我们根据癌症相关的 CpG 高甲基化谱评估了模型与其亲本肿瘤之间基于 DNA 甲基化的相似性。

sentences.en: We identified the 144,571 CpGs unmethylated in normal tissues as described above.
sentences.zh: 如上所述，我们在正常组织中鉴定了 144,571 个未甲基化的 CpG。

sentences.en: For each HCMI cancer type, we further selected CpGs hypermethylated (β value of >0.3) in at least two samples.
sentences.zh: 对于每种 HCMI 癌症类型，我们进一步在至少两个样本中选择高甲基化的 CpG（β 值 >0.3）。

sentences.en: Then we compared the Pearson’s correlation coefficient (r) as a similarity score for the following samples: (1) models and their matched tumours; (2) models and unmatched tumours from the same cancer type; and (3) models and unmatched tumours from different cancer types.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们将皮尔逊相关系数（r）作为以下样本的相似性得分进行比较：（1）模型及其匹配的肿瘤； (2) 同一癌症类型的模型和不匹配的肿瘤； (3)来自不同癌症类型的模型和不匹配的肿瘤。

sentences.en: A P value of paired model–tumour relatedness was then determined by calculating the probability of observing an unpaired model–tumour distance equal to or smaller than the same model’s distance to all unrelated tumours that were not from the same tissue type.
sentences.zh: 然后，通过计算观察到未配对模型-肿瘤距离等于或小于同一模型与并非来自同一组织类型的所有不相关肿瘤的距离的概率，确定配对模型-肿瘤相关性的 P 值。

sentences.en: After FDR adjustment, model–tumour pairs with adjusted P ≥ 0.1 were considered to be models that were non-concordant with their original tumours.
sentences.zh: FDR调整后，调整后的P≥0.1的模型-肿瘤对被认为是与其原始肿瘤不一致的模型。

sentences.zh: RNA 分析物处理和测序

blocks.html_en: Quality assurance and QC of RNA analytes. RNA from fresh-frozen models was sent for characterization, whereas for most tumours, samples of FFPE-derived RNA were sent. Fresh-frozen RNA analytes were assayed for RNA integrity, concentration and fragment size. Samples for total RNA-seq were quantified on a TapeStation system (Agilent) and RIN scores were calculated. Model-derived RNAs with RINs > 8.0 were considered high quality. For FFPE samples, we used DV200 and fragment size to evaluate sample quality. Although we targeted input concentrations greater than 100 ng µl–1, some FFPE samples were lower.

sentences.zh: RNA 分析物的质量保证和质量控制。

sentences.zh: 来自新鲜冷冻模型的 RNA 被发送进行表征，而对于大多数肿瘤，则发送 FFPE 衍生的 RNA 样本。

sentences.en: Fresh-frozen RNA analytes were assayed for RNA integrity, concentration and fragment size.
sentences.zh: 分析新鲜冷冻的 RNA 分析物的 RNA 完整性、浓度和片段大小。

sentences.zh: 在 TapeStation 系统 (Agilent) 上对总 RNA-seq 样本进行定量，并计算 RIN 分数。

blocks.html_en: Total RNA-seq library construction. To construct total RNA-seq libraries, we used Illumina Stranded Total RNA Prep with RiboZero Gold, and we barcoded samples with individual tags, following the manufacturer’s instructions (Illumina). We prepared libraries, which we then pooled using an automated liquid-handling system to minimize variance. Typically, these were pools of 38–92 samples, depending on the available capacity on a sequencer. At every step we performed QC. We used a TapeStation system to quantify library concentrations, fragment size and distribution. As needed, pool balance and library quality were assessed using miSeq Nano single-end 50-bp sequencing.

sentences.zh: 总RNA-seq文库构建。

sentences.en: To construct total RNA-seq libraries, we used Illumina Stranded Total RNA Prep with RiboZero Gold, and we barcoded samples with individual tags, following the manufacturer’s instructions (Illumina).
sentences.zh: 为了构建总 RNA-seq 文库，我们使用了 Illumina Stranded Total RNA Prep 和 RiboZero Gold，并按照制造商的说明 (Illumina) 用单独的标签对样品进行了条形码标记。

sentences.en: We prepared libraries, which we then pooled using an automated liquid-handling system to minimize variance.
sentences.zh: 我们准备了文库，然后使用自动液体处理系统将其合并以尽量减少差异。

sentences.en: Typically, these were pools of 38–92 samples, depending on the available capacity on a sequencer.
sentences.zh: 通常，这些样本池包含 38-92 个样本，具体取决于测序仪的可用容量。

sentences.en: At every step we performed QC.
sentences.zh: 我们在每一步都进行了质量控制。

sentences.en: We used a TapeStation system to quantify library concentrations, fragment size and distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 TapeStation 系统来量化文库浓度、片段大小和分布。

sentences.en: As needed, pool balance and library quality were assessed using miSeq Nano single-end 50-bp sequencing.
sentences.zh: 根据需要，使用 miSeq Nano 单端 50 bp 测序评估池平衡和文库质量。

blocks.html_en: Total RNA-seq. We prepared indexed libraries and ran them on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000, using paired-end 100 bp reads and generating a minimum of 150 million reads per sample library, with a target of greater than 90% mapped reads. In all but a few cases, all data were from the same sequencing run. For the few samples that needed additional read depth, we provided this with a secondary sequencing run. We demultiplexed raw Illumina sequence data and converted these to fastq files while quantifying adapter and low-quality sequences. Samples were assessed for information quality by mapping reads to the human hg38 genome reference, estimating the total number of reads that mapped, the fraction of RNA reads that mapped to coding regions, the amount of rRNA in a sample, the number of genes expressed and the relative expression of housekeeping genes. The samples that passed this quality assurance and QC step were then clustered with other expression data from similar and distinct tumour types to confirm expected expression patterns. We SNP-typed atypical samples to confirm the source analyte. FASTQ files of all reads were then uploaded to the GDC repository and distributed to the analysis teams.

sentences.zh: 总 RNA 测序。

sentences.en: We prepared indexed libraries and ran them on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000, using paired-end 100 bp reads and generating a minimum of 150 million reads per sample library, with a target of greater than 90% mapped reads.
sentences.zh: 我们准备了索引文库，并在 Illumina NovaSeq 6000 上运行它们，使用双端 100 bp 读取，每个样本文库至少生成 1.5 亿个读取，目标是大于 90% 的映射读取。

sentences.en: In all but a few cases, all data were from the same sequencing run.
sentences.zh: 除少数情况外，所有数据均来自同一测序运行。

sentences.en: For the few samples that needed additional read depth, we provided this with a secondary sequencing run.
sentences.zh: 对于少数需要额外读取深度的样本，我们提供了二次测序运行。

sentences.en: We demultiplexed raw Illumina sequence data and converted these to fastq files while quantifying adapter and low-quality sequences.
sentences.zh: 我们对原始 Illumina 序列数据进行多路分离，并将其转换为 fastq 文件，同时量化接头和低质量序列。

sentences.en: Samples were assessed for information quality by mapping reads to the human hg38 genome reference, estimating the total number of reads that mapped, the fraction of RNA reads that mapped to coding regions, the amount of rRNA in a sample, the number of genes expressed and the relative expression of housekeeping genes.
sentences.zh: 通过将读数映射到人类 hg38 基因组参考、估计映射的读数总数、映射到编码区的 RNA 读数的分数、样本中 rRNA 的量、表达的基因数量以及管家基因的相对表达，评估样本的信息质量。

sentences.en: The samples that passed this quality assurance and QC step were then clustered with other expression data from similar and distinct tumour types to confirm expected expression patterns.
sentences.zh: 然后，通过此质量保证和 QC 步骤的样本与来自相似和不同肿瘤类型的其他表达数据进行聚类，以确认预期的表达模式。

sentences.zh: 我们对非典型样品进行 SNP 分型以确认来源分析物。

blocks.html_en: MicroRNA (miRNA)-seq library construction. miRNA-seq library construction used a v4 NEXTflex Small RNA-seq kit (PerkinElmer), then samples were barcoded with individual tags following the manufacturer’s instructions. We prepared libraries on a Sciclone liquid-handling workstation. We performed QC at every step and quantified the libraries using a TapeStation system and an Agilent Bioanalyzer using a Small RNA Analysis kit. Pooled libraries were then size-selected according to specifications from a NEXTflex kit. Post-sequencing quality assurance and QC evaluated the abundance and diversity of miRNA. Data that passed were provided to the GDC.

blocks.html_en: Transcriptional relatedness measurements

sentences.zh: 转录相关性测量

blocks.html_en: MOMA subtype identification. To compare tumour subtypes in HCMI to those previously identified in TCGA, using the network-based MOMA algorithm33, we used the OncoMatch algorithm38 (see below). Specifically, we assessed the similarity of each HCMI sample to those in the subtypes identified by MOMA in TCGA. As these methods compare samples on the basis of the conservation of their master regulator proteins, which are highly enriched in mechanistic determinants of tumour cell state37,132,133,134, this approach effectively complements the Celligner and DNA-methylation analyses. Specifically, this analysis helps refine subtype classification by mitigating potential confounding effects in gene expression profiles—such as those related to tissue histology, unrelated to tumour biology—as well as effectively mitigating technical batch effects33. Master regulators, although rarely mutated, have crucial roles in cancer progression, as they orchestrate transcriptional networks that are disrupted by upstream genomic alterations, which makes them critical therapeutic targets38,39, including in clinical trials135,136. As such, they are more conserved in each tumour subtype than the corresponding transcriptional profiles33,132. In the following sections, we discuss the various algorithms used in this analysis.

sentences.zh: MOMA 亚型识别。

sentences.en: To compare tumour subtypes in HCMI to those previously identified in TCGA, using the network-based MOMA algorithm33, we used the OncoMatch algorithm38 (see below).
sentences.zh: 为了使用基于网络的 MOMA 算法 33 将 HCMI 中的肿瘤亚型与之前在 TCGA 中识别的肿瘤亚型进行比较，我们使用了 OncoMatch 算法 38（见下文）。

sentences.en: Specifically, we assessed the similarity of each HCMI sample to those in the subtypes identified by MOMA in TCGA.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们评估了每个 HCMI 样本与 MOMA 在 TCGA 中识别的亚型的相似性。

sentences.en: As these methods compare samples on the basis of the conservation of their master regulator proteins, which are highly enriched in mechanistic determinants of tumour cell state37,132,133,134, this approach effectively complements the Celligner and DNA-methylation analyses.
sentences.zh: 由于这些方法在其主调节蛋白的保守性的基础上比较样本，这些蛋白在肿瘤细胞状态的机制决定因素中高度富集37,132,133,134，因此这种方法有效地补充了 Celligner 和 DNA 甲基化分析。

sentences.en: Specifically, this analysis helps refine subtype classification by mitigating potential confounding effects in gene expression profiles—such as those related to tissue histology, unrelated to tumour biology—as well as effectively mitigating technical batch effects33.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，该分析通过减轻基因表达谱中的潜在混杂效应（例如与组织组织学相关、与肿瘤生物学无关的混杂效应）以及有效减轻技术批次效应来帮助完善亚型分类33。

sentences.en: Master regulators, although rarely mutated, have crucial roles in cancer progression, as they orchestrate transcriptional networks that are disrupted by upstream genomic alterations, which makes them critical therapeutic targets38,39, including in clinical trials135,136.
sentences.zh: 主调控因子虽然很少发生突变，但在癌症进展中发挥着至关重要的作用，因为它们协调被上游基因组改变破坏的转录网络，这使得它们成为关键的治疗靶标38,39，包括在临床试验中135,136。

sentences.en: As such, they are more conserved in each tumour subtype than the corresponding transcriptional profiles33,132.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们在每种肿瘤亚型中比相应的转录谱更加保守33,132。

sentences.en: In the following sections, we discuss the various algorithms used in this analysis.
sentences.zh: 在以下部分中，我们将讨论此分析中使用的各种算法。

blocks.html_en: Original MOMA analysis. In brief, MOMA is based on the assumption that transcriptional cell states are implemented and homeostatically maintained by small, autoregulated modules of master regulator proteins, comprising transcription factors (TFs) and co-factors (co-TFs). We assessed the activities of all TFs and co-TFs using the VIPER algorithm137, which is based on the expression of their transcriptional targets, which we inferred using the ARACNe algorithm138. Tumour subtypes (n = 112) were then identified by clustering samples based on TF–co-TF activity, using the ‘partitioning around medoids’ algorithm139. Below, we describe VIPER and ARACNe.

sentences.zh: MOMA 原创分析。

sentences.en: In brief, MOMA is based on the assumption that transcriptional cell states are implemented and homeostatically maintained by small, autoregulated modules of master regulator proteins, comprising transcription factors (TFs) and co-factors (co-TFs).
sentences.zh: 简而言之，MOMA 基于这样的假设：转录细胞状态是由主调节蛋白的小型自动调节模块实现和稳态维持的，这些模块包括转录因子 (TF) 和辅助因子 (co-TF)。

sentences.en: We assessed the activities of all TFs and co-TFs using the VIPER algorithm137, which is based on the expression of their transcriptional targets, which we inferred using the ARACNe algorithm138.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 VIPER 算法137评估了所有 TF 和 co-TF 的活性，该算法基于其转录目标的表达，这是我们使用 ARACNe 算法推断的138。

sentences.en: Tumour subtypes (n = 112) were then identified by clustering samples based on TF–co-TF activity, using the ‘partitioning around medoids’ algorithm139.
sentences.zh: 然后使用“围绕中心点分区”算法，通过基于 TF-co-TF 活动的样本聚类来识别肿瘤亚型 (n = 112)。

sentences.en: Below, we describe VIPER and ARACNe.
sentences.zh: 下面，我们介绍一下 VIPER 和 ARACNe。

blocks.html_en: MOMA subtype comparison. To compare HCMI samples to those in the 112 MOMA subtypes in TCGA, we first used the metaVIPER algorithm140 to compute the activity of all TFs and co-TFs. MetaVIPER—a multinetwork version of the original VIPER algorithm137 that integrates the protein activities assessed by each network—enabled the use of networks from multiple TCGA cohorts that were matched to the histology of HCMI samples (Extended Data Table 1). Enrichment of the top 50 most differentially activated genes in a HCMI sample (that is, 25 most active and 25 most inactive) in TFs–co-TFs that were differentially expressed in each TCGA MOMA subtype were used to assess their similarity (with the OncoMatch algorithm). Indeed, we have shown that across all TCGA cohorts, >80% of the functional mutations in each sample are in pathways upstream of the top 50 master regulators. Moreover, we have shown that changing the number of master regulators between 20 and 200 does not significantly affect the OncoMatch statistics33.

sentences.zh: MOMA 亚型比较。

sentences.en: To compare HCMI samples to those in the 112 MOMA subtypes in TCGA, we first used the metaVIPER algorithm140 to compute the activity of all TFs and co-TFs.
sentences.zh: 为了将 HCMI 样本与 TCGA 中 112 个 MOMA 亚型中的样本进行比较，我们首先使用 metaVIPER 算法140 来计算所有 TF 和 co-TF 的活动。

sentences.en: MetaVIPER—a multinetwork version of the original VIPER algorithm137 that integrates the protein activities assessed by each network—enabled the use of networks from multiple TCGA cohorts that were matched to the histology of HCMI samples (Extended Data Table 1).
sentences.zh: MetaVIPER——原始 VIPER 算法的多网络版本137，集成了每个网络评估的蛋白质活性——使得能够使用来自多个 TCGA 队列的网络，这些队列与 HCMI 样本的组织学相匹配（扩展数据表 1）。

sentences.en: Enrichment of the top 50 most differentially activated genes in a HCMI sample (that is, 25 most active and 25 most inactive) in TFs–co-TFs that were differentially expressed in each TCGA MOMA subtype were used to assess their similarity (with the OncoMatch algorithm).
sentences.zh: HCMI 样本中前 50 个差异最大的激活基因（即 25 个最活跃的和 25 个最不活跃的）在每个 TCGA MOMA 亚型中差异表达的 TF-co-TF 中进行富集，用于评估它们的相似性（使用 OncoMatch 算法）。

sentences.en: Indeed, we have shown that across all TCGA cohorts, >80% of the functional mutations in each sample are in pathways upstream of the top 50 master regulators.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们已经表明，在所有 TCGA 队列中，每个样本中 >80% 的功能突变位于前 50 个主调控因子的上游通路中。

sentences.en: Moreover, we have shown that changing the number of master regulators between 20 and 200 does not significantly affect the OncoMatch statistics33.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们已经表明，在 20 到 200 之间改变主调节器的数量不会显着影响 OncoMatch 统计数据33。

blocks.html_en: MetaVIPER analysis. For the analyses in this paper, we used the most recent version of the metaVIPER algorithm140. The main difference is that we replaced the original method for performing gene set analysis (aREA) by nonparametric analytical-rank-based enrichment analysis (NaRnEA)141, which improved the assessment of significance for differentially active proteins. For implementing NaRnEA, we used the matrix_narnea() function in the PISCES R package142. For each sample, TF–co-TF transcriptional targets (that is, regulatory networks) were inferred by ARACNe analysis of one or more lineage-matched TCGA cohorts. In brief, metaVIPER estimates the differential activity of each regulatory protein by integrating the NES statistics produced by VIPER analysis using each of the selected networks. VIPER assesses the activity of a protein by assessing the NES of its activated and repressed targets in genes that were differentially expressed in a signature of interest.

sentences.zh: MetaVIPER 分析。

sentences.en: For the analyses in this paper, we used the most recent version of the metaVIPER algorithm140.
sentences.zh: 对于本文的分析，我们使用了最新版本的 metaVIPER 算法140。

blocks.html_en: Differential expression signature generation. To remove batch effects between TCGA and HCMI samples, TPM-normalized gene expression profiles were first processed using a variational autoencoder (VAE) model called scGEN143. For subtype stratification, for which the goal is to assess differentially active proteins in samples in the same cohort, differential expression signatures for VIPER analysis were optimally computed by comparing each sample to the centroid of the entire cohort. We accomplished this by subtracting the median expression across all samples and then dividing by the median absolute deviation (MAD). To prevent division by zero, MAD values <0.01 were set to 0.01. For both HCMI and TCGA, we downloaded the TPM-normalized gene expression for protein-coding transcripts from the GDC portal144. The cancer-specific networks used in the analysis were inferred by ARACNe as described below.

blocks.html_en: Regulatory network inference. Regulatory networks for each HCMI cohort were generated by analysing the gene expression profiles in their lineage-matched TCGA cohorts using ARACNe3 (ref. 141). ARACNe3 is the latest incarnation of the ARACNe algorithm138. The algorithm identifies regulatory protein–target interactions on the basis of the greatest conservation of the transferred information, as assessed by computing the mutual information on the direct path and on every indirect path traversing an intermediary TF–co-TF protein, based on the data-processing inequality145.

sentences.zh: 监管网络推断。

sentences.en: Regulatory networks for each HCMI cohort were generated by analysing the gene expression profiles in their lineage-matched TCGA cohorts using ARACNe3 (ref.
sentences.zh: 每个 HCMI 队列的监管网络是通过使用 ARACNe3 分析其谱系匹配的 TCGA 队列中的基因表达谱而生成的（参考文献 1）。

blocks.html_en: To generate cancer-type-specific networks, we applied ARACNe3 to TPM-normalized expression profiles across 32 TCGA cohorts (ACC, BLCA, BRCA, CESC, CHOL, COAD, DLBC, ESCA, GBM, HNSC, KICH, KIRC, KIRP, LGG, LIHC, LUAD, LUSC, MESO, OV, PAAD, PCPG, PRAD, READ, SARC, SKCM, STAD, TGCT, THCA, THYM, UCEC, UCS and UVM). Each ARACNe3 network was inferred by subsampling the gene expression profiles until ≥50 targets were identified for each TF–co-TF in the consensus network. The analysis included 1,645 TFs and 1,556 co-TFs, retrieved from ref. 146 and ref. 147, respectively. Networks were pruned to the 100 most significant targets for each regulatory protein, based on consensus mutual information statistics. For TCGA–ESCA, we inferred networks for adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, separately.
