sentences.en: For TCGA–ESCA, we inferred networks for adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, separately.
sentences.zh: 对于 TCGA-ESCA，我们分别推断腺癌和鳞状细胞癌的网络。

blocks.html_en: OncoMatch analysis. OncoMatch38 was used to assess the similarity between HCMI and TCGA samples based on a weighted enrichment analysis of their differential protein activities. First, we computed the differential protein activities for each of n = 112 MOMA subtypes, as assessed by analysis of 20 cohorts with sufficient size for the analysis, including BLCA, BRCA, COAD, GBM, HNSC, KIRC, LAML, LGG, LIHC, LUAD, LUSC, OV, PAAD, PRAD, READ, SARC, SKCM, STAD, THCA and UCEC. Specifically, for each subtype, we generated an average protein activity (consensus protein activity signature) by integrating its VIPER-inferred NES values across each sample in the subtype, using Stouffer’s z score method. Then, we generated a P value to assess the similarity of each HCMI sample to each MOMA subtype in its lineage-matched cohorts. This was accomplished by assessing the following criteria: (1) the enrichment of the top 50 most differentially active protein (top and bottom 25) in the HCMI sample in a protein differentially active in the consensus protein activity signature of each MOMA subtype using NaRnEA; (2) the enrichment of the top 50 most differentially active protein (top and bottom 25) in the consensus protein activity signature of each MOMA subtype in a protein differentially active in the HCMI sample; and (3) by integrating the two using Stouffer’s method.

sentences.zh: OncoMatch 分析。

sentences.en: OncoMatch38 was used to assess the similarity between HCMI and TCGA samples based on a weighted enrichment analysis of their differential protein activities.
sentences.zh: OncoMatch38 用于基于差异蛋白活性的加权富集分析来评估 HCMI 和 TCGA 样本之间的相似性。

sentences.en: First, we computed the differential protein activities for each of n = 112 MOMA subtypes, as assessed by analysis of 20 cohorts with sufficient size for the analysis, including BLCA, BRCA, COAD, GBM, HNSC, KIRC, LAML, LGG, LIHC, LUAD, LUSC, OV, PAAD, PRAD, READ, SARC, SKCM, STAD, THCA and UCEC.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们计算了每个 n = 112 个 MOMA 亚型的差异蛋白活性，通过对 20 个具有足够分析规模的队列进行分析来评估，包括 BLCA、BRCA、COAD、GBM、HNSC、KIRC、LAML、LGG、LIHC、LUAD、LUSC、OV、PAAD、PRAD、READ、SARC、SKCM、STAD、THCA 和 UCEC。

sentences.en: Specifically, for each subtype, we generated an average protein activity (consensus protein activity signature) by integrating its VIPER-inferred NES values across each sample in the subtype, using Stouffer’s z score method.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，对于每个亚型，我们使用 Stouffer 的 z 评分方法，通过整合该亚型中每个样本的 VIPER 推断 NES 值，生成平均蛋白质活性（共有蛋白质活性特征）。

sentences.en: Then, we generated a P value to assess the similarity of each HCMI sample to each MOMA subtype in its lineage-matched cohorts.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们生成一个 P 值来评估每个 HCMI 样本与其谱系匹配队列中每个 MOMA 亚型的相似性。

sentences.en: This was accomplished by assessing the following criteria: (1) the enrichment of the top 50 most differentially active protein (top and bottom 25) in the HCMI sample in a protein differentially active in the consensus protein activity signature of each MOMA subtype using NaRnEA; (2) the enrichment of the top 50 most differentially active protein (top and bottom 25) in the consensus protein activity signature of each MOMA subtype in a protein differentially active in the HCMI sample; and (3) by integrating the two using Stouffer’s method.
sentences.zh: 这是通过评估以下标准来实现的：(1) 使用 NaRnEA 富集 HCMI 样品中前 50 个活性差异最大的蛋白质（顶部和底部 25 个），该蛋白质在每个 MOMA 亚型共有蛋白质活性特征中具有差异活性； (2) HCMI 样品中差异活性蛋白中每个 MOMA 亚型的共有蛋白活性特征中前 50 个差异最大的活性蛋白（顶部和底部 25 个）的富集； (3) 使用斯托弗方法整合两者。

blocks.html_en: HCMI samples may show high similarity to more than one subtype. As such, a final assignment was performed as follows. As the tumour and the model samples were derived from the same tumour mass, we assumed that their subtype assignment should be conserved. Thus, among all MOMA subtypes producing a significant match to a model and its parental tumour P < 0.05, one-tailed, Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted, we selected the subtype with their best integrated Stouffer score. If no agreement was identified (that is, no MOMA subtype with significant OncoMatch score for both the model and its parental tumour), then the two were independently assigned to their best scoring MOMA subtype. For simplicity, we mapped HCMI colorectal, oesophageal–gastric and GBM samples only to COAD, STAD and GBM MOMA subtypes in TCGA, respectively, thus excluding subtypes from READ, ESCA and LGG. A null model for the OncoMatch analysis was generated by generating a probability density of OncoMatch NES scores matching each HCMI sample to all non-lineage-related TCGA subtypes. A one-tail P value was assessed, as the only relevant result would be for the HCMI OncoMatch score to be larger than the OncoMatch from the null hypothesis.

sentences.en: HCMI samples may show high similarity to more than one subtype.
sentences.zh: HCMI 样本可能与不止一种亚型表现出高度相似性。

sentences.en: As such, a final assignment was performed as follows.
sentences.zh: 因此，最终分配如下。

sentences.zh: 由于肿瘤和模型样本来自相同的肿瘤块，我们假设它们的亚型分配应该是保守的。

sentences.en: Thus, among all MOMA subtypes producing a significant match to a model and its parental tumour P < 0.05, one-tailed, Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted, we selected the subtype with their best integrated Stouffer score.
sentences.zh: 因此，在与模型及其亲本肿瘤 P < 0.05、单尾、Benjamini-Hochberg 调整显着匹配的所有 MOMA 亚型中，我们选择了具有最佳综合 Stouffer 评分的亚型。

sentences.en: If no agreement was identified (that is, no MOMA subtype with significant OncoMatch score for both the model and its parental tumour), then the two were independently assigned to their best scoring MOMA subtype.
sentences.zh: 如果没有发现一致（即模型及其亲代肿瘤的 OncoMatch 评分均不显着），则将两者独立分配给其最佳评分 MOMA 亚型。

sentences.en: For simplicity, we mapped HCMI colorectal, oesophageal–gastric and GBM samples only to COAD, STAD and GBM MOMA subtypes in TCGA, respectively, thus excluding subtypes from READ, ESCA and LGG.
sentences.zh: 为简单起见，我们仅将 HCMI 结直肠、食管胃和 GBM 样本分别映射到 TCGA 中的 COAD、STAD 和 GBM MOMA 亚型，从而排除 READ、ESCA 和 LGG 中的亚型。

sentences.en: A null model for the OncoMatch analysis was generated by generating a probability density of OncoMatch NES scores matching each HCMI sample to all non-lineage-related TCGA subtypes.
sentences.zh: 通过生成将每个 HCMI 样本与所有非谱系相关 TCGA 亚型相匹配的 OncoMatch NES 分数的概率密度，生成 OncoMatch 分析的空模型。

sentences.en: A one-tail P value was assessed, as the only relevant result would be for the HCMI OncoMatch score to be larger than the OncoMatch from the null hypothesis.
sentences.zh: 评估单尾 P 值，因为唯一相关结果是 HCMI OncoMatch 评分大于原假设的 OncoMatch 评分。

blocks.html_en: Tumour–model similarity analysis. The transcriptional state similarity between models and their parental tumours was also assessed based on OncoMatch statistics. Differential expression signatures for VIPER analysis were computed by further normalizing and scaling the TPM-normalized gene expression data by subtracting the median expression across all same type samples (that is, tumours or models) in the same HCMI cohort and dividing by the MAD. Again, to prevent division by zero, MAD values <0.01 were set to 0.01. Differential gene expression was assessed separately for tumours and models to avoid sample type related batch effects. For small cohorts (n ≤ 10 samples), we used the median and the MAD of lineage-matched samples that they belonged to. Specifically, the following cohorts were normalized together: (1) intrahepatic, extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma; (2) all sarcoma types, including bone cancer and desmoid tumours; and (3) tubulovillous adenoma, rare gastrointestinal cancers and colorectal cancer. Similar to the above analysis, we inferred protein activity using metaVIPER with the NaRnEA enrichment analysis algorithm and cancer-type-specific networks. For instance, some HCMI cohorts (for example, COAD) could be matched to multiple lineage networks inferred from TCGA cohorts (that is, COAD and READ). Thus, we assessed protein activities for colorectal, lung, bile duct–liver, brain and gastroesophageal samples in HCMI using COAD–READ, LUAD–LUSC, LIHC–CHOL, GBM–LGG and ESCA–STAD networks, respectively. For rare cohorts that lacked sufficient samples to perform ARACNe analyses, (that is, Wilms tumour, small intestine cancer, gallbladder cancer and unknown carcinoma), we leveraged the ability of metaVIPER to automatically integrate across multiple networks. Specifically, we selected the three networks that produced the greatest differential activity for the top 50 proteins. The rationale is that incorrect networks can only decrease but not increase activity (that is, the more unrelated the network, the smaller the differential activity). To avoid diluting the results based on subpar networks, networks that produced significantly lower differential activity for each protein were excluded from the analysis. We also normalized samples in rare cohorts together with the samples identified as having the best matching networks.

sentences.en: Differential expression signatures for VIPER analysis were computed by further normalizing and scaling the TPM-normalized gene expression data by subtracting the median expression across all same type samples (that is, tumours or models) in the same HCMI cohort and dividing by the MAD.
sentences.zh: VIPER 分析的差异表达特征是通过进一步标准化和缩放 TPM 标准化基因表达数据来计算的，方法是减去同一 HCMI 队列中所有相同类型样本（即肿瘤或模型）的中值表达并除以 MAD。

sentences.en: Again, to prevent division by zero, MAD values <0.01 were set to 0.01.
sentences.zh: 同样，为了防止被零除，MAD 值 <0.01 被设置为 0.01。

sentences.en: Differential gene expression was assessed separately for tumours and models to avoid sample type related batch effects.
sentences.zh: 分别评估肿瘤和模型的差异基因表达，以避免样本类型相关的批次效应。

sentences.en: For small cohorts (n ≤ 10 samples), we used the median and the MAD of lineage-matched samples that they belonged to.
sentences.zh: 对于小队列（n ≤ 10 个样本），我们使用它们所属的谱系匹配样本的中位数和 MAD。

sentences.en: Specifically, the following cohorts were normalized together: (1) intrahepatic, extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma; (2) all sarcoma types, including bone cancer and desmoid tumours; and (3) tubulovillous adenoma, rare gastrointestinal cancers and colorectal cancer.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，将以下队列一起标准化：（1）肝内、肝外胆管癌和肝细胞癌； (2)所有肉瘤类型，包括骨癌和硬纤维瘤； (3)管状绒毛状腺瘤、罕见的胃肠癌和结直肠癌。

sentences.en: Similar to the above analysis, we inferred protein activity using metaVIPER with the NaRnEA enrichment analysis algorithm and cancer-type-specific networks.
sentences.zh: 与上述分析类似，我们使用 metaVIPER 以及 NaRnEA 富集分析算法和癌症类型特异性网络推断蛋白质活性。

sentences.en: For instance, some HCMI cohorts (for example, COAD) could be matched to multiple lineage networks inferred from TCGA cohorts (that is, COAD and READ).
sentences.zh: 例如，一些 HCMI 队列（例如 COAD）可以与从 TCGA 队列（即 COAD 和 READ）推断出的多个谱系网络相匹配。

sentences.en: Thus, we assessed protein activities for colorectal, lung, bile duct–liver, brain and gastroesophageal samples in HCMI using COAD–READ, LUAD–LUSC, LIHC–CHOL, GBM–LGG and ESCA–STAD networks, respectively.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们分别使用 COAD-READ、LUAD-LUSC、LIHC-CHOL、GBM-LGG 和 ESCA-STAD 网络评估了 HCMI 中结直肠、肺、胆管-肝脏、大脑和胃食管样本的蛋白质活性。

sentences.en: For rare cohorts that lacked sufficient samples to perform ARACNe analyses, (that is, Wilms tumour, small intestine cancer, gallbladder cancer and unknown carcinoma), we leveraged the ability of metaVIPER to automatically integrate across multiple networks.
sentences.zh: 对于缺乏足够样本进行 ARACNe 分析的罕见队列（即肾母细胞瘤、小肠癌、胆囊癌和未知癌症），我们利用 metaVIPER 自动整合多个网络的能力。

sentences.en: Specifically, we selected the three networks that produced the greatest differential activity for the top 50 proteins.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们选择了对前 50 种蛋白质产生最大差异活性的三个网络。

sentences.en: The rationale is that incorrect networks can only decrease but not increase activity (that is, the more unrelated the network, the smaller the differential activity).
sentences.zh: 其基本原理是，不正确的网络只能减少而不能增加活动（即网络越不相关，差异活动越小）。

sentences.en: To avoid diluting the results based on subpar networks, networks that produced significantly lower differential activity for each protein were excluded from the analysis.
sentences.zh: 为了避免稀释基于低于标准网络的结果，对每种蛋白质产生显着较低差异活性的网络被排除在分析之外。

sentences.en: We also normalized samples in rare cohorts together with the samples identified as having the best matching networks.
sentences.zh: 我们还对稀有群组中的样本以及被确定为具有最佳匹配网络的样本进行了标准化。

blocks.html_en: To generate a conservative, nonparametric null-model, we computed the probability density function (PDF) of the NES generated by matching each model with all the non-lineage-matched tumours in HCMI. To improve the PDF estimate, which was highly non-Gaussian, we bootstrapped null-model generation 1,000 times using 60% of the non-lineage-matched samples and used the resulting PDF to convert matched tumour–model pair values to z scores. As both positive and negative NES were integrated, we used Stouffer’s method to generate integrated z scores. Tumour–model pairs with FDR > 0.1 were considered poor matches.

sentences.en: To generate a conservative, nonparametric null-model, we computed the probability density function (PDF) of the NES generated by matching each model with all the non-lineage-matched tumours in HCMI.
sentences.zh: 为了生成保守的非参数零模型，我们计算了通过将每个模型与 HCMI 中所有非谱系匹配的肿瘤进行匹配而生成的 NES 的概率密度函数 (PDF)。

sentences.en: To improve the PDF estimate, which was highly non-Gaussian, we bootstrapped null-model generation 1,000 times using 60% of the non-lineage-matched samples and used the resulting PDF to convert matched tumour–model pair values to z scores.
sentences.zh: 为了改进高度非高斯的 PDF 估计，我们使用 60% 的非谱系匹配样本引导空模型生成 1,000 次，并使用生成的 PDF 将匹配的肿瘤模型对值转换为 z 分数。

sentences.en: As both positive and negative NES were integrated, we used Stouffer’s method to generate integrated z scores.
sentences.zh: 由于正 NES 和负 NES 均已积分，因此我们使用 Stouffer 方法生成积分 z 分数。

sentences.en: Tumour–model pairs with FDR > 0.1 were considered poor matches.
sentences.zh: FDR > 0.1 的肿瘤模型对被认为匹配不佳。

blocks.html_en: Celligner. To align our HCMI collection to publicly available collections of tumours (TCGA and TARGET) and models (CCLE), we used Celligner31, a computational framework to integrate and compare multiple gene expression datasets. Initially, we attempted to expand the tumour and model datasets by directly merging the transcriptional profile of the HCMI collection. However, this approach resulted in poor alignment of the data (Supplementary Fig. 10a). To address this, we expanded on the established Celligner approach by aligning the HCMI dataset to the existing reference datasets in a two-step process. First, we replicated the alignment of TCGA and TARGET tumours onto the CCLE cell lines to create a reference tumour–model map, as described in the original Celligner publication31 . Subsequently, we introduced the HCMI dataset into this integrated space.

sentences.zh: 塞利格纳。

sentences.en: To align our HCMI collection to publicly available collections of tumours (TCGA and TARGET) and models (CCLE), we used Celligner31, a computational framework to integrate and compare multiple gene expression datasets.
sentences.zh: 为了使我们的 HCMI 集合与公开可用的肿瘤集合（TCGA 和 TARGET）和模型 (CCLE) 保持一致，我们使用 Celligner31，这是一个用于集成和比较多个基因表达数据集的计算框架。

sentences.en: Initially, we attempted to expand the tumour and model datasets by directly merging the transcriptional profile of the HCMI collection.
sentences.zh: 最初，我们尝试通过直接合并 HCMI 集合的转录谱来扩展肿瘤和模型数据集。

sentences.en: However, this approach resulted in poor alignment of the data (Supplementary Fig. 10a).
sentences.zh: 然而，这种方法导致数据对齐不良（补充图 10a）。

sentences.en: To address this, we expanded on the established Celligner approach by aligning the HCMI dataset to the existing reference datasets in a two-step process.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们扩展了已建立的 Celligner 方法，通过两步过程将 HCMI 数据集与现有参考数据集对齐。

sentences.en: First, we replicated the alignment of TCGA and TARGET tumours onto the CCLE cell lines to create a reference tumour–model map, as described in the original Celligner publication31 .
sentences.zh: 首先，我们将 TCGA 和 TARGET 肿瘤的比对复制到 CCLE 细胞系上，以创建参考肿瘤模型图，如原始 Celligner 出版物中所述31。

sentences.en: Subsequently, we introduced the HCMI dataset into this integrated space.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们将 HCMI 数据集引入到这个集成空间中。

blocks.html_en: In brief, using contrastive PCA, we identified gene expression signatures elevated in the TCGA–TARGET tumour collection compared with the CCLE models, consistent with the results reported in the original Celligner analysis (Supplementary Fig. 10b). These signatures were enriched for pathways related to immune and non-malignant features, including stromal cell enrichment (Supplementary Fig. 10b). To mitigate the influence of these non-malignant features, we removed the contrastive principal components (cPCs) associated with these signatures before proceeding to the next steps. We then applied mutual nearest neighbours (MNN) batch correction as part of the Celligner algorithm to align the datasets.

sentences.en: In brief, using contrastive PCA, we identified gene expression signatures elevated in the TCGA–TARGET tumour collection compared with the CCLE models, consistent with the results reported in the original Celligner analysis (Supplementary Fig. 10b).
sentences.zh: 简而言之，使用对比 PCA，我们发现与 CCLE 模型相比，TCGA-TARGET 肿瘤集合中的基因表达特征有所升高，这与原始 Celligner 分析中报告的结果一致（补充图 10b）。

sentences.en: These signatures were enriched for pathways related to immune and non-malignant features, including stromal cell enrichment (Supplementary Fig. 10b).
sentences.zh: 这些特征富集了与免疫和非恶性特征相关的通路，包括基质细胞富集（补充图10b）。

sentences.en: To mitigate the influence of these non-malignant features, we removed the contrastive principal components (cPCs) associated with these signatures before proceeding to the next steps.
sentences.zh: 为了减轻这些非恶性特征的影响，我们在继续下一步之前删除了与这些特征相关的对比主成分 (cPC)。

sentences.en: We then applied mutual nearest neighbours (MNN) batch correction as part of the Celligner algorithm to align the datasets.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们应用相互最近邻 (MNN) 批量校正作为 Celligner 算法的一部分来对齐数据集。

blocks.html_en: Using this aligned gene expression space as a reference, we integrated the HCMI models and tumours. Specifically, we removed the cPCs increased in the HCMI dataset, which were similarly enriched for immune-related gene signatures (Supplementary Fig. 10c), correlated to DNA-based tumour impurity assessment (Supplementary Fig. 10d) and then we applied MNN batch correction. For this integration, we removed the first three cPCs, which maximized the number of MNN pairs (Supplementary Fig. 10e) and aligned well with the expected variability in the dataset through gene-set enrichment analysis of gene expression profiles. We used a k1 value of 20 and k2 value of 50 for MNN, as recommended by the Celligner developers, to reflect differences in dataset size and composition. The results suggested that the HCMI tumour collection exhibited similar levels of variability and contamination as the reference TCGA–TARGET dataset.

sentences.en: Using this aligned gene expression space as a reference, we integrated the HCMI models and tumours.
sentences.zh: 使用这个对齐的基因表达空间作为参考，我们整合了 HCMI 模型和肿瘤。

sentences.en: Specifically, we removed the cPCs increased in the HCMI dataset, which were similarly enriched for immune-related gene signatures (Supplementary Fig. 10c), correlated to DNA-based tumour impurity assessment (Supplementary Fig. 10d) and then we applied MNN batch correction.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们删除了 HCMI 数据集中增加的 cPC，这些 cPC 同样富集了免疫相关基因特征（补充图 10c），与基于 DNA 的肿瘤杂质评估相关（补充图 10d），然后我们应用了 MNN 批量校正。

sentences.en: For this integration, we removed the first three cPCs, which maximized the number of MNN pairs (Supplementary Fig. 10e) and aligned well with the expected variability in the dataset through gene-set enrichment analysis of gene expression profiles.
sentences.zh: 对于这种整合，我们删除了前三个 cPC，这最大化了 MNN 对的数量（补充图 10e），并通过基因表达谱的基因集富集分析与数据集中的预期变异性很好地对齐。

sentences.en: We used a k1 value of 20 and k2 value of 50 for MNN, as recommended by the Celligner developers, to reflect differences in dataset size and composition.
sentences.zh: 按照 Celligner 开发人员的建议，我们对 MNN 使用 k1 值 20 和 k2 值 50，以反映数据集大小和组成的差异。

sentences.en: The results suggested that the HCMI tumour collection exhibited similar levels of variability and contamination as the reference TCGA–TARGET dataset.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，HCMI 肿瘤集合表现出与参考 TCGA-TARGET 数据集相似的变异性和污染水平。

blocks.html_en: After integrating all datasets, we performed PCA on the combined data and calculated pairwise Euclidean distances between all tumours and models in the 70-PC space. These distances formed the basis for all Celligner distance-based analyses that we described in this study. To visualize the integrated data, we created a 2D UMAP embedding based on the 70 PCs for visualization (Supplementary Table 11).

sentences.en: After integrating all datasets, we performed PCA on the combined data and calculated pairwise Euclidean distances between all tumours and models in the 70-PC space.
sentences.zh: 整合所有数据集后，我们对组合数据进行 PCA 并计算 70-PC 空间中所有肿瘤和模型之间的成对欧几里德距离。

sentences.en: These distances formed the basis for all Celligner distance-based analyses that we described in this study.
sentences.zh: 这些距离构成了我们在本研究中描述的所有基于 Celligner 距离的分析的基础。

sentences.en: To visualize the integrated data, we created a 2D UMAP embedding based on the 70 PCs for visualization (Supplementary Table 11).
sentences.zh: 为了可视化集成数据，我们基于 70 台 PC 创建了 2D UMAP 嵌入以进行可视化（补充表 11）。

blocks.html_en: To measure transcriptional relatedness between matched HCMI model–tumour pairs, we used the Celligner distances, which represent the Euclidean distance between a model and its paired tumour in 70-PC space. A P value of paired model–tumour relatedness was then determined by calculating the probability that an unpaired model–tumour distance equal to or smaller than the same model’s distance to all unrelated tumours that were not from the same tissue type. After FDR adjustment, model–tumour pairs with adjusted P values equal to or greater than 0.1 were considered to be models that were non-concordant with their original tumours. Relatedness of tumour lineage is as indicated in Supplementary Table 12.

sentences.en: To measure transcriptional relatedness between matched HCMI model–tumour pairs, we used the Celligner distances, which represent the Euclidean distance between a model and its paired tumour in 70-PC space.
sentences.zh: 为了测量匹配的 HCMI 模型-肿瘤对之间的转录相关性，我们使用了 Celligner 距离，它代表了 70-PC 空间中模型与其配对肿瘤之间的欧几里得距离。

sentences.en: A P value of paired model–tumour relatedness was then determined by calculating the probability that an unpaired model–tumour distance equal to or smaller than the same model’s distance to all unrelated tumours that were not from the same tissue type.
sentences.zh: 然后通过计算未配对的模型-肿瘤距离等于或小于同一模型与并非来自同一组织类型的所有不相关肿瘤的距离的概率来确定配对模型-肿瘤相关性的 P 值。

sentences.en: After FDR adjustment, model–tumour pairs with adjusted P values equal to or greater than 0.1 were considered to be models that were non-concordant with their original tumours.
sentences.zh: FDR 调整后，调整后 P 值等于或大于 0.1 的模型-肿瘤对被认为是与其原始肿瘤不一致的模型。

sentences.en: Relatedness of tumour lineage is as indicated in Supplementary Table 12.
sentences.zh: 肿瘤谱系的相关性如补充表12所示。

blocks.html_en: Expression data input for Celligner. TARGET samples (n = 784) and TCGA expression data (n = 9,806) were obtained from the Xena browser (https://xenabrowser.net). Cell line gene expression data for 1,377 samples were taken from the DepMap Public 19Q4 file. HCMI dataset expression data were downloaded from the GDC portal, and TPM unstranded data were used for only protein-coding genes. Gene expression data were then log2 transformed after adding a pseudocount of 1. Finally, we subset gene expression data to the 18,550 protein-coding genes that were present in all datasets for all Celligner analyses.

sentences.zh: Celligner 的表达数据输入。

sentences.en: TARGET samples (n = 784) and TCGA expression data (n = 9,806) were obtained from the Xena browser (https://xenabrowser.net). Cell line gene expression data for 1,377 samples were taken from the DepMap Public 19Q4 file.
sentences.zh: TARGET 样本 (n = 784) 和 TCGA 表达数据 (n = 9,806) 从 Xena 浏览器 (https://xenabrowser.net) 获得。 1,377 个样本的细胞系基因表达数据取自 DepMap Public 19Q4 文件。

sentences.zh: HCMI数据集表达数据从GDC门户下载，TPM非链数据仅用于蛋白质编码基因。

sentences.zh: 然后在添加伪计数 1 后对基因表达数据进行 log2 转换。

blocks.html_en: Euclidean and latent TF (OHSU methods) preprocessing. The unique genetic and molecular distribution call for each cancer cohort (for example, pancreatic cancer) and specimen type (that is, tumour or derived model) for these groupings suggested that each be run independently through the following pipeline. We filtered RNA gene expression data for biologically relevant features (the combined set of feature-selected genes of top methods from TCGA trained algorithms)32. For instances where it was needed for analysis, we aggregated multiple TCGA cohorts to more closely match the specific cancer types included in HCMI cohorts (that is, the HCMI lung cancer cohort included TCGA LUAD and LUSC cohorts; the HCMI STAD–ESCC cohort included TCGA GEA and ESCC cohorts; the HCMI kidney cohort included KIRP, KIRC and KICH TCGA cohorts). Any remaining cohorts with low sample size (n < 8) were statistically underpowered and excluded from downstream analysis.

sentences.en: Euclidean and latent TF (OHSU methods) preprocessing.
sentences.zh: 欧几里得和潜在 TF（OHSU 方法）预处理。

sentences.en: The unique genetic and molecular distribution call for each cancer cohort (for example, pancreatic cancer) and specimen type (that is, tumour or derived model) for these groupings suggested that each be run independently through the following pipeline.
sentences.zh: 每个癌症队列（例如胰腺癌）和这些分组的样本类型（即肿瘤或衍生模型）的独特遗传和分子分布要求表明每个分组都可以通过以下管道独立运行。

sentences.zh: 我们过滤了 RNA 基因表达数据的生物学相关特征（来自 TCGA 训练算法的顶级方法的特征选择基因的组合集）32。

sentences.en: For instances where it was needed for analysis, we aggregated multiple TCGA cohorts to more closely match the specific cancer types included in HCMI cohorts (that is, the HCMI lung cancer cohort included TCGA LUAD and LUSC cohorts; the HCMI STAD–ESCC cohort included TCGA GEA and ESCC cohorts; the HCMI kidney cohort included KIRP, KIRC and KICH TCGA cohorts).
sentences.zh: 对于需要进行分析的情况，我们汇总了多个 TCGA 队列，以更紧密地匹配 HCMI 队列中包含的特定癌症类型（即 HCMI 肺癌队列包括 TCGA LUAD 和 LUSC 队列；HCMI STAD-ESCC 队列包括 TCGA GEA 和 ESCC 队列；HCMI 肾脏队列包括 KIRP、KIRC 和 KICH TCGA 队列）。

sentences.zh: 任何剩余的样本量较小的队列 (n < 8) 在统计上动力不足，并被排除在下游分析之外。

blocks.html_en: Euclidean distance calculation. Euclidean-based distances were measured in a group (for example, in pancreatic tumours). First, we computed the mean pairwise gene Euclidean distances. For example, we generated a list of pairwise gene distances by calculating all gene distances between pairs of samples. We reported the sample pair distance as the mean of this list. We then repeated the process for all sample pairs, reporting sample pairs for both tumour–tumour pairs for intracohort similarity and tumour–model matched pairs for derived model similarity. We report the z score of these distances and identified outliers as (>3 z score).

sentences.zh: 欧氏距离计算。

sentences.en: Euclidean-based distances were measured in a group (for example, in pancreatic tumours).
sentences.zh: 在一组中测量基于欧几里德的距离（例如，在胰腺肿瘤中）。

sentences.en: First, we computed the mean pairwise gene Euclidean distances.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们计算平均成对基因欧几里德距离。

sentences.en: For example, we generated a list of pairwise gene distances by calculating all gene distances between pairs of samples.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们通过计算样本对之间的所有基因距离来生成成对基因距离列表。

sentences.en: We reported the sample pair distance as the mean of this list.
sentences.zh: 我们将样本对距离报告为该列表的平均值。

sentences.en: We then repeated the process for all sample pairs, reporting sample pairs for both tumour–tumour pairs for intracohort similarity and tumour–model matched pairs for derived model similarity.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们对所有样本对重复该过程，报告肿瘤-肿瘤对的样本对以获得组内相似性，并报告肿瘤-模型匹配对的样本对以获得导出的模型相似性。

sentences.en: We report the z score of these distances and identified outliers as (>3 z score).
sentences.zh: 我们报告这些距离的 z 分数，并将异常值识别为（> 3 z 分数）。

blocks.html_en: Latent TF distance calculation. Latent TF distances were generated using neural networks. Specifically, a variational autoencoder model (NetVae) was trained with gene expression of normal tissues from all TCGA cohorts and genotype–tissue expression (GTEx). These datasets were aligned using quantile ranking. On a gene-wise basis, we calculated the summed difference between a HCMI sample (tumour or model) and normal tissue. These deviation scores were then correlated with mutations and encoded into latent space. The same methods described in the section ‘Euclidean distance calculation’ were applied to these latent values to generate the latent TF distances. Both intracohort and intercohort distances were calculated.

sentences.zh: 潜在 TF 距离计算。

sentences.en: Latent TF distances were generated using neural networks.
sentences.zh: 潜在 TF 距离是使用神经网络生成的。

sentences.en: Specifically, a variational autoencoder model (NetVae) was trained with gene expression of normal tissues from all TCGA cohorts and genotype–tissue expression (GTEx).
sentences.zh: 具体来说，使用来自所有 TCGA 队列的正常组织的基因表达和基因型组织表达 (GTEx) 来训练变分自动编码器模型 (NetVae)。

sentences.en: These datasets were aligned using quantile ranking.
sentences.zh: 这些数据集使用分位数排名进行对齐。

sentences.en: On a gene-wise basis, we calculated the summed difference between a HCMI sample (tumour or model) and normal tissue.
sentences.zh: 在基因方面，我们计算了 HCMI 样本（肿瘤或模型）与正常组织之间的总差异。

sentences.en: These deviation scores were then correlated with mutations and encoded into latent space.
sentences.zh: 然后将这些偏差分数与突变相关联并编码到潜在空间中。

sentences.en: The same methods described in the section ‘Euclidean distance calculation’ were applied to these latent values to generate the latent TF distances.
sentences.zh: 将“欧几里得距离计算”部分中描述的相同方法应用于这些潜在值以生成潜在 TF 距离。

sentences.en: Both intracohort and intercohort distances were calculated.
sentences.zh: 计算组内和组间距离。

blocks.html_en: Multiclass pair classification-based distance calculation. We observed that relative gene expression was effective in removing batch effects across different datasets. When we plotted TCGA data using the relative expression of the most variable 500 genes on UMAP space and mapped HCMI samples to the plot, we found that data were clustered on the basis of tissue type. This was in contrast to continuous gene expression data, which clustered data in cohorts. Given this, we used a multiclass pair classification-based approach to compute the distances between matched tumour–model pairs. The multiclass pair classification algorithm148 uses the relative expression between gene pairs as input and is an extension to multiple classes of the k-top-scoring pairs algorithm149 that was developed for binary classification. We regressed out the purity effects in both TMP and HCMI data and found that removing purity effects did not make subtypes indistinguishable. We applied the best model selected over cross validations in TMP data to HCMI models and tumours and computed the pairwise Euclidean distances between the assignment probabilities of each HCMI sample to TMP cohort subtypes. We labelled a matched tumour–model distance as an outlier if it was above Q3 + 1.5 × IQR of the tumour–model distances in the TMP cohort.

sentences.zh: 基于多类对分类的距离计算。

sentences.en: We observed that relative gene expression was effective in removing batch effects across different datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到相对基因表达可以有效消除不同数据集的批次效应。

sentences.en: When we plotted TCGA data using the relative expression of the most variable 500 genes on UMAP space and mapped HCMI samples to the plot, we found that data were clustered on the basis of tissue type.
sentences.zh: 当我们使用 UMAP 空间上变化最大的 500 个基因的相对表达来绘制 TCGA 数据并将 HCMI 样本映射到图中时，我们发现数据根据组织类型进行聚类。

sentences.en: This was in contrast to continuous gene expression data, which clustered data in cohorts.
sentences.zh: 这与连续基因表达数据形成鲜明对比，连续基因表达数据将数据聚集在队列中。

sentences.en: Given this, we used a multiclass pair classification-based approach to compute the distances between matched tumour–model pairs.
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，我们使用基于多类对分类的方法来计算匹配的肿瘤模型对之间的距离。

sentences.en: The multiclass pair classification algorithm148 uses the relative expression between gene pairs as input and is an extension to multiple classes of the k-top-scoring pairs algorithm149 that was developed for binary classification.
sentences.zh: 多类对分类算法 148 使用基因对之间的相对表达作为输入，是针对二元分类而开发的 k-top-scoring 对算法 149 的多类的扩展。

sentences.en: We regressed out the purity effects in both TMP and HCMI data and found that removing purity effects did not make subtypes indistinguishable.
sentences.zh: 我们对 TMP 和 HCMI 数据中的纯度影响进行了回归，发现消除纯度影响并不会使亚型无法区分。

sentences.en: We applied the best model selected over cross validations in TMP data to HCMI models and tumours and computed the pairwise Euclidean distances between the assignment probabilities of each HCMI sample to TMP cohort subtypes.
sentences.zh: 我们将 TMP 数据交叉验证中选择的最佳模型应用于 HCMI 模型和肿瘤，并计算每个 HCMI 样本与 TMP 队列亚型的分配概率之间的成对欧几里德距离。

sentences.en: We labelled a matched tumour–model distance as an outlier if it was above Q3 + 1.5 × IQR of the tumour–model distances in the TMP cohort.
sentences.zh: 如果匹配的肿瘤模型距离高于 TMP 队列中肿瘤模型距离的 Q3 + 1.5 × IQR，我们将其标记为异常值。

blocks.html_en: Canonical parallel direction. We transformed and normalized the combined gene expression matrix using the variance-stabilizing transform from DESeq2 (ref. 150) then split the matrix into separate tumour and model matrices. We calculated the canonical parallel direction (CPD) by taking the difference between tumour–model pairs and then performing PCA on the resulting difference matrix with the R package irlba (https://github.com/bwlewis/irlba). We took the CPD as the first loading vector. We derived distances by projecting individual expression matrices onto the CPD to obtain a score, and we took the difference in scores between model–tumour pairs as the CPD distance. We labelled samples as outliers when their distance was greater than two standard deviations from the mean.

sentences.zh: 规范平行方向。

sentences.en: We transformed and normalized the combined gene expression matrix using the variance-stabilizing transform from DESeq2 (ref.
sentences.zh: 我们使用 DESeq2 的方差稳定变换对组合基因表达矩阵进行变换和归一化（参考文献 1）。

sentences.en: 150) then split the matrix into separate tumour and model matrices.
sentences.zh: 150）然后将矩阵分成单独的肿瘤和模型矩阵。

sentences.en: We calculated the canonical parallel direction (CPD) by taking the difference between tumour–model pairs and then performing PCA on the resulting difference matrix with the R package irlba (https://github.com/bwlewis/irlba). We took the CPD as the first loading vector.
sentences.zh: 我们通过获取肿瘤模型对之间的差异，然后使用 R 包 irlba (https://github.com/bwlewis/irlba) 对所得差异矩阵执行 PCA 来计算规范平行方向 (CPD)。我们将 CPD 作为第一个加载向量。

sentences.zh: 当样本与平均值的距离大于两个标准差时，我们将样本标记为异常值。

blocks.html_en: HCMI and CCLE model coverage comparison

sentences.en: HCMI and CCLE model coverage comparison
sentences.zh: HCMI 和 CCLE 模型覆盖率比较

blocks.html_en: A critical rationale for model generation is to provide proxies for in vitro or in vivo studies of tumour biology. As a result, it is critical to assess what fraction of the tumours in a large-scale repository (for example, TCGA) are associated with effective proxies in large model repositories such as CCLE and HCMI. For this purpose, we assessed the fraction of TCGA tumours that had at least one high-fidelity matched model in CCLE and HCMI. Specifically, we identified high-fidelity models as those producing an OncoMatch score of NES ≥ 10, as previously discussed38,39.

sentences.en: A critical rationale for model generation is to provide proxies for in vitro or in vivo studies of tumour biology.
sentences.zh: 模型生成的一个关键原理是为肿瘤生物学的体外或体内研究提供代理。

sentences.en: As a result, it is critical to assess what fraction of the tumours in a large-scale repository (for example, TCGA) are associated with effective proxies in large model repositories such as CCLE and HCMI.

blocks.html_en: For this purpose, we generated violin plots representing the probability density of the highest OncoMatch NES scores against each model in HCMI, CCLE and the joint repository of HCMI and CCLE models. Gene expression profiles were then centred by subtracting the median expression across all samples and dividing by the MAD. As discussed in previous sections, we used MetaVIPER to assess the activity of TF and co-TF proteins, using regulatory networks generated by ARACNe analysis of the TCGA cohort from which each tumour sample was selected.

blocks.html_en: Tumour molecular pathology subtype predictions

blocks.html_en: We predicted the subtype of each sample using TMP models32. These models were trained on molecular data (gene expression, CNV, DNA methylation, miRNA expression and somatic mutations) from TCGA primary tumours. We included a library of models that used either one data type or multiple data types. We applied models that used only gene expression, or DNA methylation, to HCMI samples because of their top performance with TCGA data. We quantile-ranked gene expression data before application. For each sample, we report a single subtype by considering all models and their model confidence values (for example, we report the consensus subtype of the five independent models that were run for ovarian samples).

blocks.html_en: Frozen samples (n = 34, from 17 tumour–model pairs) were obtained from the BPC Nationwide Children’s Hospital, DFCI and ATCC. Nucleus isolation was performed using a Chromium Nuclei Isolation kit with RNase inhibitor (10x Genomics, 1000494). Samples were homogenized using a pestle in lysis buffer, passed through a column and centrifuged in debris-removal buffer to eliminate residual tissue and debris. The isolated nuclei were then washed, resuspended and loaded onto a 10x Chromium platform for gel bead-in-emulsion (GEM) generation and barcoding. Following GEM reverse transcription, samples underwent post-GEM RT cleanup and cDNA amplification. After quality control and quantification of cDNA, libraries were prepared using the Chromium Single Cell 3′ Gene Expression Library Construction protocol and sequenced on a NovaSeq platform.

blocks.html_en: We aligned snRNA-seq short-read data from 17 tumour–model pairs (34 samples) multiplexed across 16 runs, generated by the Columbia University Single Cell Analysis Core, including 7 GBM, 6 PAAD and 4 COAD pairs, to the prebuilt 10x Genomics human reference genome GRCh38-2024-A, using 10x Genomics Cell Ranger software (v.8.0.1)152. Expression data were processed with cellranger count on the pre-built human reference, which encompassed 38,606 features. Cell Ranger performsd default filtering for QC, and generates filtered feature–barcode matrix files (filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5; barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv, and matrix.mts) containing unique molecular identifier (UMI) counts for genes for each run.

blocks.html_en: snRNA-seq demultiplexing

sentences.zh: snRNA-seq 解复用

blocks.html_en: To recover sample-specific profiles for samples processed in the same 10x Chromium flow cell, we demultiplexed the Cell Ranger output152 using Demuxlet153. As Demuxlet requires a list of sample-specific SNPs as an input, we called germline variants for each human sample from the matched normal WGS data. To limit the number of false-positive doublets, which are common in snRNA-seq demultiplexing owing to background RNA and potential large duplications or deletions shared by tumours in the same cohort, we used the gnomADv4 exome data to subset only the most likely germline variants. Specifically, we retained only biallelic SNPs that met the following criteria: (1) population MAF ≥ 0.1%; (2) identified in the gnomADv4 WES cohort154; and (3) flagged as PASS in gnomAD. We ran Demuxlet with the following parameters: --field GT and --group-list barcodes.txt, where ‘barcodes.txt’ was the cell barcode file generated by Cell Ranger. As previously recommended155 for demultiplexing snRNA-seq samples, we assigned cells to a sample and used these cells in downstream analyses only if the BEST column of the Demuxlet-generated <Cell Ranger run >.best file started with ‘SNG-’ or the BEST column started with ‘DBL-’ and the PRB.DBL column contained a value of ≤0.99. We classified droplet barcodes with ‘DBL-’ in the BEST column and >0.99 in the PRB.DBL column as doublets, whereas those labelled with AMB were unassigned; droplets labelled as doublet or unassigned were excluded from downstream analyses.

blocks.html_en: snRNA-seq gene expression analysis

blocks.html_en: UMI matrices for each demultiplexed sample were processed using Scanpy (v.1.9.3)156. For QC, we only retained cells with <25% mitochondrial RNA content and UMI counts in the range (800; 50,000). To recover more cells in tumour samples with low cell counts (that is, cases HCM-BROD-0110-C25 and HCM-CSHL-0073-C25), we increased the mitochondrial RNA content threshold to 35% and removed the lower bound on UMI counts. To recover more cells from a run that included three COAD tumours, we removed the threshold on mitochondrial RNA content while maintaining an upper UMI count limit of 100,000. Owing to the low number of cells in the tumour from case HCM-CSHL-0247-C18, we excluded this tumour–model pair from downstream analyses. As a result, we analysed 16 tumour–model pairs: 7 for GBM, 6 for PAAD and 3 for COAD. For statistics on UMI counts before and after QC for individual samples, refer to Supplementary Table 8. UMI counts were normalized, log transformed and scaled, following the standard Scanpy preprocessing workflow. PCA was performed with the ‘arpack’ solver (‘scanpy.tl.pca’). The nearest-neighbour distance matrix was computed with ‘scanpy.pp.neighbors’, setting ‘n_neighbors’ = 15 (default). UMAP embeddings were computed using ‘scanpy.tl.umap’, and PCA and UMAP visualizations were generated with the ‘scanpy.pl.pca’ and ‘scanpy.pl.umap’ functions. For analyses involving dimensionality reduction and visualization of tumour–model pairs or involving multiple cases, the same single-sample workflow was applied by re-scaling the multi-sample concatenated data. Individual samples were clustered using the resolution-optimized Leiden clustering algorithm via the acdc-py wrapper for the Scanpy’s Leiden implementation (https://pypi.org/project/acdc-py/). We determined the optimal number of clusters by varying resolution values from 0.01 to 1.01 in 0.01 increments, selecting the solution that produced the highest average Silhouette score.

blocks.html_en: Copy number and putative malignant cells detection

sentences.en: Copy number and putative malignant cells detection
sentences.zh: 拷贝数和假定的恶性细胞检测

blocks.html_en: We inferred CNAs from expression counts at the single-nucleus level using the inferCNV package157. We clustered nuclei according to their unsupervised clustering labels, based on gene expression. A reference set of 2,193 nuclei (1,840 oligodendrocytes and 352 microglia) were sampled from four GBM tumours (HCM-BROD-0199-C71, HCM-BROD-0415-C71, HCM-BROD-0012-C71 and HCM-BROD-0002-C71). We used these reference nuclei as controls to infer CNAs in GBM samples. We used a reference set of 3,592 nuclei (2,112 fibroblasts and 1,480 stellate cells) sampled from 6 PAAD tumours (HCM-CSHL-0078-C25 primary and metastatic, HCM-CSHL-0089-C25 primary and metastatic, HCM-CSHL-0073-C25 and HCM-BROD-0110-C25) to infer CNAs in each PAAD sample. We labelled cell types in the references (oligodendrocytes, microglia, fibroblasts and stellate cells) via over-representation analysis (ORA) using the Python decoupler package with canonical human markers (‘brain’ and ‘immune system’ for GBMs; ‘pancreas’, ‘immune system’ and ‘connective tissue’ for PAAD) from the PanglaoDB database158,159. We sampled a reference set of 435 nuclei (annotated as macrophages by SingleR) sampled from HCM-BROD-0001-C18, and we used the only COAD sample that had enough non-epithelial cells to infer CNAs in each COAD sample. The following parameters were used in each inferCNV run: cutoff=0.1, window_length = 101, HMM=TRUE, mode=’i6’, analysis_mode = ‘subclusters’, denoise=TRUE. To classify putative malignant cells, we compared the inferred CNAs in each snRNA-seq sample to the CNAs detected by WGS in matched bulk samples. Cells were labelled as malignant if they belonged to a cluster with those CNAs.

sentences.en: We used a reference set of 3,592 nuclei (2,112 fibroblasts and 1,480 stellate cells) sampled from 6 PAAD tumours (HCM-CSHL-0078-C25 primary and metastatic, HCM-CSHL-0089-C25 primary and metastatic, HCM-CSHL-0073-C25 and HCM-BROD-0110-C25) to infer CNAs in each PAAD sample.

sentences.en: We labelled cell types in the references (oligodendrocytes, microglia, fibroblasts and stellate cells) via over-representation analysis (ORA) using the Python decoupler package with canonical human markers (‘brain’ and ‘immune system’ for GBMs; ‘pancreas’, ‘immune system’ and ‘connective tissue’ for PAAD) from the PanglaoDB database158,159.
sentences.zh: 我们使用Python解耦器包和来自PanglaoDB数据库的规范人类标记（GBM的“大脑”和“免疫系统”；PAAD的“胰腺”、“免疫系统”和“结缔组织”）通过过度代表性分析（ORA）标记了参考文献中的细胞类型（少突胶质细胞、小胶质细胞、成纤维细胞和星状细胞）158,159。

sentences.en: We sampled a reference set of 435 nuclei (annotated as macrophages by SingleR) sampled from HCM-BROD-0001-C18, and we used the only COAD sample that had enough non-epithelial cells to infer CNAs in each COAD sample.
sentences.zh: 我们从 HCM-BROD-0001-C18 中采样了 435 个细胞核（由 SingleR 注释为巨噬细胞）的参考集，并且我们使用唯一具有足够非上皮细胞的 COAD 样本来推断每个 COAD 样本中的 CNA。

sentences.en: The following parameters were used in each inferCNV run: cutoff=0.1, window_length = 101, HMM=TRUE, mode=’i6’, analysis_mode = ‘subclusters’, denoise=TRUE.
sentences.zh: 每次 inferCNV 运行中使用以下参数：cutoff=0.1、window_length = 101、HMM=TRUE、mode='i6'、analysis_mode ='subclusters'、denoise=TRUE。

sentences.en: To classify putative malignant cells, we compared the inferred CNAs in each snRNA-seq sample to the CNAs detected by WGS in matched bulk samples.
sentences.zh: 为了对假定的恶性细胞进行分类，我们将每个 snRNA-seq 样本中推断的 CNA 与 WGS 在匹配的批量样本中检测到的 CNA 进行了比较。

sentences.en: Cells were labelled as malignant if they belonged to a cluster with those CNAs.
sentences.zh: 如果细胞属于具有这些 CNA 的簇，则细胞被标记为恶性。

blocks.html_en: snRNA-seq profiles from GBM samples first underwent coarse-grain cell-type assignment via ORA, using the decoupler Python package with canonical human markers for the brain from the PanglaoDB database158,159. To address the low signal-to-noise ratio inherent in snRNA-seq data, we performed soft gene imputation by summing the UMI counts of the ten nearest neighbours of each nucleus before running ORA. We labelled nuclei not labelled as ‘oligodendrocytes’ or ‘microglia’ and belonging to clusters of putative malignant cells from inferCNV analysis as ‘malignant’ and assigned these cells to specific cellular states, as described below.

blocks.html_en: For each GBM nucleus labelled as malignant, a gene expression signature was computed as follows: \({z}_{i}^{(k)}=\frac{{x}_{i}^{(k)}-{\overline{x}}_{\mathrm{ref}}}{{\sigma }_{\mathrm{ref}}}\), where \({x}_{i}^{(k)}\) is the d-dimensional vector of ln(x + 1)-transformed gene expression for nucleus i in snRNA-seq sample k (with d equal to the number of genes), and \({\overline{x}}_{\mathrm{ref}}\) and \({\sigma }_{\mathrm{ref}}\) are the d-dimensional vectors representing the mean and standard deviation of ln(x + 1)-transformed gene expression across all malignant GBM snRNA-seq profiles, respectively. We performed gene set enrichment analysis of each gene expression signature across the six subtypes—NPC1-like, NPC2-like, MES1-like, MES2-like AC-like and OPC-like—as previously identified40, using the NaRnEA algorithm141. For this purpose, we used the Python package ‘pyVIPER’160. Each gene set comprised 39–50 genes that represented distinct cellular states. We then assigned each nucleus to the subtype that produced the maximum NaRnEA NES. Nuclei with the smallest P value (>0.15) were assigned no cellular state and were labelled as unknown. For simplicity, we combined the NPC1-like and NPC2-like subtypes into a single NPC-like subtype; similarly, we merged the MES1-like and MES-2 like subtypes into a single MES-like subtype.

blocks.html_en: Cell-type calling for PAAD and COAD samples

blocks.html_en: For each PAAD and COAD snRNA-seq profile, an initial coarse-grain cell-type assignment was performed using the Python implementation of SingleR using the Blueprint-ENCODE reference161,162. SingleR computes the correlation between each individual nucleus and every sample in the reference. It then labels each nucleus with the cell type with the highest average correlation. To deal with the low signal-to-noise ratio characteristic of snRNA-seq data, before to running SingleR, we applied soft gene imputation using a metacell approach. That is, by adding the UMI counts of the ten nearest neighbours of each nucleus using scanpy.pp.neighbors (Euclidean distance). Nuclei with an ‘epithelial cell’ annotation, which were also classified as putative malignant cells on the basis of inferCNV analysis, were labelled as malignant and assigned to specific transcriptional states, as detailed below. In the COAD cohort, we also retained a small subset of putative malignant cells annotated as ‘neurons’ by SingleR, as these were likely to be malignant cells with neuroendocrine features.

blocks.html_en: Malignant state assignment for PAAD samples

sentences.zh: PAAD 样本的恶性状态分配

blocks.html_en: For nuclei derived from PAAD samples, we used a subtype classification strategy similar to that for GBM. We tested three classification strategies proposed in the literature, including those proposed by ref. 163, ref. 34 ref. 43; the first was from bulk profiles and the other were two from single-cell profiles. For the first two, we used the same methodology described for the GBM samples. For the latter, we performed the comparison at the protein activity level. Specifically, protein activity in malignant cells was assessed using metaVIPER140 by integrating six PAAD gene regulatory networks, which we generated independently from distinct PAAD cohorts, including single-cell profiles (scNET)43, laser microdissected samples (CUMC-net)164, the TCGA PAAD cohort (TCGA-net)165, the ICGC PAAD cohort (ICGC-net)166, the UNC cohort (UNC-net)163 and single-cell profiles from HCMI samples (HCMI-net). These networks captured regulatory interactions for TFs, co-TFs, signalling proteins and surface markers. For the first five networks, detailed information for the generation has been previously provided43. The HCMI-net was generated from snRNA-seq profiles from malignant nuclei in the HCMI PAAD cohort using ARACNe3 (ref. 141), with metacell generation constructed using the ‘pyviper.pp.repr_metacells’ function as input (the metacell approach adaptively aims at a target median depth of 10,000 UMIs per metacell whenever feasible). Although this target was not always met, a minimum depth of 8,432 UMIs was reached, which ensured robust representation of the gene expression profiles. To avoid bias associated with different regulon size, all regulons were pruned to the 100 most significant targets based on mutual information analysis. We then classified each single cell on the basis of three main PAAD transcriptional lineages identified as previously described43, including GLS, MOS and PLS. Classification was based on the significance of the NaRnEA-based NES representing the enrichment of the top 100 most differentially active proteins in each single nucleus (50 most activated and 50 most inactivated proteins) differentially active in the GLS, MOS and PLS signatures. Each nucleus was assigned to the cell state with the highest NaRnEA-inferred NES. Nuclei in which the highest-scoring subtype had a P > 0.15 were assigned to no specific transcriptional state and were labelled as ‘unknown’.

blocks.html_en: For each nucleus in the COAD cohort, we computed a gene expression signature using the same methodology as applied to GBM and PAAD samples. Enrichment of each signature for two previously reported intrinsic subtypes, iCMS2 and iCMS3 (ref. 167), was calculated using NaRnEA based on the 50 most overexpressed and 50 most underexpressed genes in each signature. Each nucleus was assigned to the cellular state corresponding to the highest NES, whereas nuclei with a P  >0.15 value were labelled as unknown. The vast majority of cells in HCM-CSHL-0143-C20 and HCM-CSHL-0322-C20 were classified as iCMS2, the predominant epithelial state, which is enriched in tumours with strong WNT and MYC signalling activation167,168. We identified a subset of iCMS3 cells, typically in tumours with substantial immune activation and metabolic dysregulation167,168, in the HCM-BROD-0001-C18 tumour–model pair (about 50% in the tumour, around 20% in the model; Extended Data Fig. 8b,c). Although the proportions of iCMS2 and iCMS3 cells differed between the tumour and model, the analysis demonstrated that the model effectively recapitulated both cell states that were observed in the parental tumour.

blocks.html_en: Medium-switching assay

sentences.zh: 介质切换分析

blocks.html_en: To assess transcriptional plasticity driven by culture media, HCM-BROD-0416-C71 GBM cells, originally maintained in NSA medium, were transitioned to formulated-conditioned medium. After initial recovery and expansion in NSA medium, cells were plated on laminin-coated culture vessels and, following 24 h of adhesion, switched to formulated-conditioned medium for either 72 h or 2 weeks. Cells were then fixed and stained for the indicated markers and imaged using the Operetta CLS High-Content Analysis system (Revvity). Full experimental details are provided in the Supplementary Methods.

sentences.en: To assess transcriptional plasticity driven by culture media, HCM-BROD-0416-C71 GBM cells, originally maintained in NSA medium, were transitioned to formulated-conditioned medium.
sentences.zh: 为了评估培养基驱动的转录可塑性，将最初维持在 NSA 培养基中的 HCM-BROD-0416-C71 GBM 细胞转移到配制的条件培养基中。

sentences.en: After initial recovery and expansion in NSA medium, cells were plated on laminin-coated culture vessels and, following 24 h of adhesion, switched to formulated-conditioned medium for either 72 h or 2 weeks.
sentences.zh: 在 NSA 培养基中初步恢复和扩增后，将细胞铺板于层粘连蛋白包被的培养容器上，粘附 24 小时后，转至配制的条件培养基中培养 72 小时或 2 周。

sentences.en: Cells were then fixed and stained for the indicated markers and imaged using the Operetta CLS High-Content Analysis system (Revvity).
sentences.zh: 然后将细胞固定并染色指定标记，并使用 Operetta CLS 高内涵分析系统 (Revvity) 进行成像。

sentences.en: Full experimental details are provided in the Supplementary Methods.
sentences.zh: 补充方法中提供了完整的实验细节。

blocks.html_en: In vitro drug-sensitivity testing

sentences.zh: 体外药物敏感性测试

blocks.html_en: Patient-derived GBM cells were maintained in NSA medium supplemented with epidermal growth factor and fibroblast growth factor under standard culture conditions28,51. For drug-sensitivity assays, cells were seeded at a density of 2,000 cells per well in ultra-low-attachment 96-well plates. Twenty-four hours after seeding, temozolomide was dispensed using a D300e digital dispenser in an 8-point titration series (0.03–300 µM). Cell viability was assessed after 5 days using a CellTiter-Glo luminescent assay (Promega).

sentences.en: Patient-derived GBM cells were maintained in NSA medium supplemented with epidermal growth factor and fibroblast growth factor under standard culture conditions28,51.
sentences.zh: 患者来源的 GBM 细胞在标准培养条件下维持在补充有表皮生长因子和成纤维细胞生长因子的 NSA 培养基中28,51。

sentences.en: For drug-sensitivity assays, cells were seeded at a density of 2,000 cells per well in ultra-low-attachment 96-well plates.
sentences.zh: 对于药物敏感性测定，细胞以每孔 2,000 个细胞的密度接种在超低附着 96 孔板中。

sentences.en: Twenty-four hours after seeding, temozolomide was dispensed using a D300e digital dispenser in an 8-point titration series (0.03–300 µM).
sentences.zh: 接种后 24 小时，使用 D300e 数字分配器以 8 点滴定系列 (0.03–300 µM) 分配替莫唑胺。

sentences.en: Cell viability was assessed after 5 days using a CellTiter-Glo luminescent assay (Promega).
sentences.zh: 5天后使用CellTiter-Glo发光测定法(Promega)评估细胞活力。

blocks.html_en: The HCMI Explorer Suite

sentences.zh: HCMI 浏览器套件

blocks.html_en: To facilitate the exploration of HCMI translational and clinical utility, we developed the HCMI Explorer Suite, a web-based application built using R Shiny (v.1.8.1.1)171. The application was developed in the R programming language (v.4.3.2) and leverages key Shiny packages such as shiny, shinydashboard and shinythemes to provide a dynamic and interactive graphical user interface. The core modules of the HCMI Explorer Suite enable users to explore treatment timelines, model-specific genomic data and transcriptional similarities between cancer models, paired tumours and reference datasets (TCGA and CCLE). All plots were generated using ggplot2 (v3.3.5), with interactive features integrated using plotly (v4.9.3). The Clinical Module uses the swimplot package172 to visualize patient treatment timelines and to track model treatment exposures. The application is deployed via Shiny Server, with all backend processing and analyses performed server-side. The source code for the app is available at GitHub (https://github.com/human-cancer-model-initiative/HCMI-Explorer-Suite), and the hosted application can be accessed online (https://appshare.cancer.gov/HCMI_Explorer_Suite/).

blocks.html_en: Ethics statement

sentences.zh: 道德声明

blocks.html_en: All human tissue samples and associated clinical data used in this study were collected as part of the HCMI under protocols approved by the Institutional Review Boards (IRBs) of the respective Cancer Model Development Centres (CMDCs) and participating clinical sites. All procedures were conducted in accordance with relevant ethical guidelines and regulations. Written informed consent was obtained from all participants before sample collection, in accordance with HCMI programme requirements and institutional policies. Each participating centre fulfilled all regulatory requirements, including IRB-approved protocols, informed consent procedures and data-sharing agreements (Supplementary Note 2).

blocks.html_en: Data availability

sentences.zh: 数据可用性

blocks.html_en: To support data access, we maintain a publicly accessible instruction portal (HCMI page at https://www.cancer.gov/ccg/research/functional-genomics/hcmi/using-hcmi), which serves as the central entry point for the resource. Molecular and genomic characterization data from this study are available through the HCMI–CMDC project on the NCI GDC web page (https://portal.gdc.cancer.gov/projects/HCMI-CMDC) and its accompanying GDC publication page (https://gdc.cancer.gov/about-data/publications/HCMI-CMDC-2026). Controlled-access raw sequencing data are available through dbGaP under study accession phs001486. Processed molecular datasets (mutation calls, copy number profiles and clinical annotations) are available through cBioPortal (https://www.cbioportal.org/study/summary?id=pancan_hcmi_2025). Interactive model-level exploration is available through the HCMI searchable catalogue (https://hcmi-searchable-catalog.nci.nih.gov).

blocks.html_en: A.C. is the founder, equity holder and consultant of DarwinHealth, a company that has licensed some of the algorithms used in this paper from Columbia University. Columbia University is also an equity holder in DarwinHealth. A.D.C. receives research funding from Bayer and consults for KaryoVerse. H.C. is an inventor on patents related to organoid research. His full disclosure can be found at www.uu.nl/staff/JCClevers/Additionalfunctions. G.G. receives research funds from IBM, Pharmacyclics/AbbVie, Bayer, Genentech, Calico and Ultima Genomics. He is also an inventor on patent applications filed by the Broad Institute related to MSMuTect, MSMutSig, POLYSOLVER, SignatureAnalyzer-GPU, MSEye and MinimuMM-seq. He is a founder, consultant and holds privately held equity in Scorpion Therapeutics; he is also a founder of, and holds privately held equity in, PreDICTA Biosciences. G.G. was also a consultant to Merck. K.L.L. is the founder, equity holder and consultant for Travera, is a consultant for Bristol Myers Squibb, Servier, Blaze Biosciences, Integragen and L.E.K. Consulting, and has received research funding to DFCI from Bristol Myers Squibb and Lilly. D.A.T. is a co-founder, consultant and holds stock options from Mestag Therapeutics; is a consultant and holds stock options from Xilis; and has received research grant support from Fibrogen, Mestag and ONO Therapeutics. M.K.’s spouse is an Illumina Field Applications employee and holds stock in the company. L.T. works at DarwinHealth, a company that has licensed some of the algorithms used in this paper from Columbia University. P.W.L. is a member of the Scientific Advisory Board of FOXO Technologies and TAGOMICS, Limited. W.R.M. is a founder, board member and scientific advisory board member of Orion Genomics, a plant genomics company (institutional affiliations: Genetics Program–SUNY Stony Brook; affiliate member: New York Genome Center). J.T.N. is an employee of Convergent Therapeutics and has received honoraria, consulting or advisory fees from Pfizer, AIQ and Bayer. E.R. participates in a research collaboration funded by Inocras. S.S. receives research funding from AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb outside the scope of this work. S.R. receives research support from Microsoft and holds equity in Amgen. The remaining authors declare no competing interests.

blocks.html_en: The diagram summarizes sequencing data generated for the HCMI cohort (n = 665 models). Counts are shown for models with available tumor, normal, and model samples, including complete trios (n = 399), pairs of model and normal (n = 233), pairs of model and tumor (n = 14), and models without matched tumor or normal samples (n = 19). For each group, the number of samples profiled by WGS, WXS, RNA-seq, and DNA methylation is indicated. In addition, 168 failed derivation attempts are included, with sequencing data available for tumor tissues (WGS, WXS, RNA-seq, and methylation).

blocks.html_en: (a) Relative contribution of each SNV signature (y-axis) in each model (y-axis). (b) Mutational signature contribution (y-axis) in 31 discordant tumor/model pairs (x-axis). Positive signature contributions indicate that the signature is enriched in the model; negative signature contributions indicate the signature is enriched in the tumor. (c) Comparison of the estimated relative timing of WGD events between models exhibiting concordant WGD in both tumor and model (n=40, min=0.17, max=1.0, median=0.82) versus those with WGD detected only in the model (n=30, min=0.001, max=1.0, median=0.93). Bars are colored by the fraction of ecDNAs that are unique to the tumor (dark red), unique to the model (light red), or are detected in both the tumor and model (blue).

sentences.zh: 扩展数据图 4 模型与其匹配肿瘤之间的转录和表观遗传一致性。

blocks.html_en: (a) Correlation between epigenetic estimate of drift between model-tumor pairs and the starting tumor’s tissue purity. Each point represents a model-tumor pair (n = 201). The line shows the linear regression fit. The correlation was assessed using a two-sided Pearson correlation test (r = 0.33, P = 1.8 x 10−6). No multiple comparison correction was applied. DNA methylation fidelity (y-axis) is the similarity score (i.e. the Pearson correlation) between each model and its matched tumor. Tumor purity (x-axis) is the DNA-based consensus tumor purity estimate (see Methods). Gray dots indicate a similarity score probability that was no different from random chance (at FDR < 0.1, see Methods). (b) Intersection of transcriptional concordance methods. An UpSet plot of model-tumor pairs evaluated by all six independent transcriptional proximity methods (n = 235): Celligner, OncoMatch, MultiClass Pair Classification Distance (MultiClass), Canonical Parallel Direction (CPD), Euclidean Distance (Euclidean), and Latent Transcription Factor Distance (Latent TF). Set size indicates the number of model-tumor pairs that were considered concordant by each method. (c) Celligner-based transcriptional distance of tumors to their models, before and after in vitro expansion. Each point represents the Celligner distance for one model relative to its matched tumor at a given timepoint. Linked points indicate the same model evaluated before and after expansion to assess transcriptional drift over time (n = 14 biologically independent models; 14 paired comparisons). The y-axis is the Celligner-based distance between each model and its parent tumor (boxes and whiskers represent medians, and 25-75th percentiles, +/- 1.5 IQR, two-sided paired t-test P = 0.13, ns = not statistically significant). (d) MR activity of a divergent model-tumor pair. Visualization of top 10 candidate MR proteins and expression of known target genes for a model (HCM-BROD-0003-C71) that does not match its tumor’s MR activity profile. MR activation or deactivation are shown in red and blue, respectively. Differential expression of target genes (DEGs) for upregulated or downregulated genes is respectively orange and purple. (e) Gene expression of GBM markers in tumors, before model derivation. GBM tumors are grouped by the culture media that we used to derive their respective models. Each point represents a biologically independent tumor sample (CM n = 3 tumors; NSA n = 37 tumors). Box plots show the median (center line) and interquartile range (box; 25th-75th percentiles); whiskers extend to +/- 1.5 IQR, and points beyond this range are plotted as outliers. ns = not statistically significant by a two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test (Mann-Whitney U test). (f) Copy number concordance between model/tumor pairs. Blue and red regions indicate, respectively, copy number losses and gains. Cases where a model has transcriptionally diverged from its parent tumor (e.g. HCM-BROD-0002-C71) display retention of inferred copy number events, suggesting transcriptional state changes.

blocks.html_en: Extended Data Fig. 5 Comparison of HCMI, TCGA and CCLE.

sentences.en: Extended Data Fig. 5 Comparison of HCMI, TCGA and CCLE.
sentences.zh: 扩展数据 图 5 HCMI、TCGA 和 CCLE 的比较。

blocks.html_en: (a) Stacked bar plot showing the number of models across major disease types in the HCMI (red) and CCLE (blue) collections, stratified by tumor status (primary vs. metastatic). Bar lengths indicate total model counts. (b) Circos plots that illustrate the copy number and mutational landscapes of the matched tumors for the rare models shown in Fig. 4b (lower). From the outside moving inward, the tracks display: chromosome ideograms, copy number profiles, and mutational patterns that highlight both driver missense and truncating mutations. Major and minor copy numbers are represented respectively by red and blue lines, while copy number gains, losses, and loss-of-heterozygosity are emphasized with red, blue, and orange shadings. The innermost track shows variant allele frequencies (VAFs) of identified mutations, with key driver mutations labeled by their gene symbols. A histologic image of the tumor-of-origin is placed at the center. (c) Comparison of tumor-type relevant driver events in patient tumor samples for HCMI (blue) and TCGA (grey) cohorts. Extended Data Fig. 5b shows driver events, including pathogenic and likely-pathogenic SNVs, high-level amplifications, and homozygous deletions in each gene. For the HCMI cohort, patient tumor samples used to directly generate the matching model were used for the comparison. Genes associated with these driver events were curated from Bailey et al.106 and supplemented by expert opinion (Supplementary Table 10). (d) A UMAP layout of CpG sites for HCMI tumors, HCMI models, and TCGA/TARGET tumors showed cancer-associated DNA hypermethylation; all cancer types in HCMI and TCGA/TARGET projects are shown. Samples are colored according to cancer type. (e) UMAP projection of Celligner-aligned gene expression data for HCMI tumors, HCMI models and TCGA/TARGET tumors, colored by cancer type. All cancer types represented in HCMI and TCGA/TARGET cohorts are shown. Samples are colored according to cancer type and shapes indicate sample types. (f) Violin plots that display protein activity similarity, assessed by OncoMatch NES, of the best model in HCMI (red), CCLE (blue), and both (green), for each TCGA tumor across 8 cancer types (lung [nHCMI:21, nCCLE:205], liver [nHCMI:1, nCCLE:24], bile duct [nHCMI:8, nCCLE:35], bone [nHCMI:2, nCCLE:39], thyroid [nHCMI:2, nCCLE:17], pancreatic [nHCMI:101, nCCLE:52], eye [nHCMI:1, nCCLE:9], and sarcoma [nHCMI:13, nCCLE:34]) out of 19 common cancer types in both datasets. Box plots show median (center line), 25–75th percentiles, and 1.5 X IQR whiskers; data points beyond this range are considered outliers and are not shown but are included in statistical analyses. Higher NES values indicate greater similarities between a tumor and a model. Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) corrected p-values from two-sided Mann-Whitney U-tests comparing NES distributions between HCMI (red) and CCLE (blue) are annotated above the violin plots. These comparisons are shown only for the superior dataset within each cancer type (lung: p=1.2x10-57; liver: p=2.9x10−42; bile duct: p=3.8x10−35; bone: p=7.8x10−29; thyroid: p=3.6x10−27; pancreatic: p=8.3x10-3). Additionally, p-values displayed above the 'All models' (green) plots indicate statistical significance between the top-performing dataset and the combined group (HCMI + CCLE), calculated via two-sided Mann-Whitney U-tests with BH correction (lung: p=3.0x10−6; liver: p=3.8x10−3; bile duct: p=1.0x10−2; bone: p=1.4x10−5; thyroid: p=3.5x10−11; pancreatic: p=8.3x10−3; eye: p=8.3x10−3; sarcoma: p=4.9x10−15). The violin plots were sorted in the order of decreasing significance of having a greater NES in CCLE models than in HCMI.

sentences.en: (d) A UMAP layout of CpG sites for HCMI tumors, HCMI models, and TCGA/TARGET tumors showed cancer-associated DNA hypermethylation; all cancer types in HCMI and TCGA/TARGET projects are shown.
sentences.zh: (d) HCMI 肿瘤、HCMI 模型和 TCGA/TARGET 肿瘤的 CpG 位点 UMAP 布局显示癌症相关 DNA 高甲基化；显示 HCMI 和 TCGA/TARGET 项目中的所有癌症类型。

sentences.en: Samples are colored according to cancer type.
sentences.zh: 样品根据癌症类型着色。

sentences.en: (e) UMAP projection of Celligner-aligned gene expression data for HCMI tumors, HCMI models and TCGA/TARGET tumors, colored by cancer type.
sentences.zh: (e) HCMI 肿瘤、HCMI 模型和 TCGA/TARGET 肿瘤的 Celligner 对齐基因表达数据的 UMAP 投影，按癌症类型着色。

sentences.en: All cancer types represented in HCMI and TCGA/TARGET cohorts are shown.
sentences.zh: 显示了 HCMI 和 TCGA/TARGET 队列中代表的所有癌症类型。

sentences.en: Samples are colored according to cancer type and shapes indicate sample types.
sentences.zh: 样品根据癌症类型着色，形状表示样品类型。

sentences.en: (f) Violin plots that display protein activity similarity, assessed by OncoMatch NES, of the best model in HCMI (red), CCLE (blue), and both (green), for each TCGA tumor across 8 cancer types (lung [nHCMI:21, nCCLE:205], liver [nHCMI:1, nCCLE:24], bile duct [nHCMI:8, nCCLE:35], bone [nHCMI:2, nCCLE:39], thyroid [nHCMI:2, nCCLE:17], pancreatic [nHCMI:101, nCCLE:52], eye [nHCMI:1, nCCLE:9], and sarcoma [nHCMI:13, nCCLE:34]) out of 19 common cancer types in both datasets.
sentences.zh: (f) 通过 OncoMatch NES 评估，对于 8 种癌症类型（肺 [nHCMI:21，nCCLE:205]、肝 [nHCMI:1、nCCLE:24]、胆管 [nHCMI:8、nCCLE:35]、骨）的每个 TCGA 肿瘤，小提琴图显示蛋白质活性相似性，通过 OncoMatch NES 评估，HCMI（红色）、CCLE（蓝色）和两者（绿色）的最佳模型两个数据集中 19 种常见癌症类型中的 [nHCMI:2，nCCLE:39]、甲状腺 [nHCMI:2、nCCLE:17]、胰腺 [nHCMI:101、nCCLE:52]、眼睛 [nHCMI:1、nCCLE:9] 和肉瘤 [nHCMI:13、nCCLE:34]）。

sentences.en: Box plots show median (center line), 25–75th percentiles, and 1.5 X IQR whiskers; data points beyond this range are considered outliers and are not shown but are included in statistical analyses.
sentences.zh: 箱线图显示中位数（中心线）、第 25-75 个百分位数和 1.5 X IQR 须线；超出此范围的数据点被视为异常值，不会显示，但会包含在统计分析中。

sentences.en: Higher NES values indicate greater similarities between a tumor and a model.
sentences.zh: NES 值越高表明肿瘤和模型之间的相似性越大。

sentences.en: Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) corrected p-values from two-sided Mann-Whitney U-tests comparing NES distributions between HCMI (red) and CCLE (blue) are annotated above the violin plots.
sentences.zh: 小提琴图上方注释了比较 HCMI（红色）和 CCLE（蓝色）之间 NES 分布的双边 Mann-Whitney U 检验的 Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) 校正 p 值。

sentences.en: These comparisons are shown only for the superior dataset within each cancer type (lung: p=1.2x10-57; liver: p=2.9x10−42; bile duct: p=3.8x10−35; bone: p=7.8x10−29; thyroid: p=3.6x10−27; pancreatic: p=8.3x10-3).

Additionally, p-values displayed above the 'All models' (green) plots indicate statistical significance between the top-performing dataset and the combined group (HCMI + CCLE), calculated via two-sided Mann-Whitney U-tests with BH correction (lung: p=3.0x10−6; liver: p=3.8x10−3; bile duct: p=1.0x10−2; bone: p=1.4x10−5; thyroid: p=3.5x10−11; pancreatic: p=8.3x10−3; eye: p=8.3x10−3; sarcoma: p=4.9x10−15).
sentences.zh: 此外，“所有模型”（绿色）图上方显示的 p 值表示表现最佳的数据集与组合组 (HCMI + CCLE) 之间的统计显着性，通过带有 BH 校正的双边 Mann-Whitney U 检验计算得出（肺：p=3.0x10−6；肝脏：p=3.8x10−3；胆管：p=1.0x10−2；骨骼：p=1.4x10−5；甲状腺：p=3.5x10−11；胰腺：p=8.3x10−3；眼睛：p=8.3x10−3；肉瘤：p=4.9x10−15）。

sentences.en: The violin plots were sorted in the order of decreasing significance of having a greater NES in CCLE models than in HCMI.
sentences.zh: 小提琴图按照 CCLE 模型中 NES 大于 HCMI 中 NES 的显着性递减顺序排序。

sentences.en: Extended Data Fig. 6 Single-nucleus characterization of tumor and models from the GBM cohort.
sentences.zh: 扩展数据图 6 GBM 队列中肿瘤和模型的单核特征。

blocks.html_en: (a) Proportion of malignant cells in GBM tumors, profiled using snRNA-seq. (b) Heatmap highlighting the top differentially regulated pathways (-log10(FDR)) in malignant cells (total cells: n = 105,944; tumors: 39,405; models: 66,539) across all GBM tumors (left) versus models (right). Pathways are derived from the MSigDB Hallmark gene set and glioma-intrinsic expression subtypes as defined by Wang et al.170 and Neftel et al.40. (c) Heatmaps highlighting the top differentially regulated pathways (-log10(FDR)) in malignant cells from individual tumor/model pairs. Pathways are derived from the MSigDB Hallmark gene set and glioma-intrinsic expression subtypes as defined by Wang et al.170 and Neftel et al.40.

sentences.en: (a) Proportion of malignant cells in GBM tumors, profiled using snRNA-seq.
sentences.zh: (a) GBM 肿瘤中恶性细胞的比例，使用 snRNA-seq 进行分析。

sentences.en: (b) Heatmap highlighting the top differentially regulated pathways (-log10(FDR)) in malignant cells (total cells: n = 105,944; tumors: 39,405; models: 66,539) across all GBM tumors (left) versus models (right).
sentences.zh: (b) 热图突出显示所有 GBM 肿瘤（左）与模型（右）的恶性细胞（细胞总数：n = 105,944；肿瘤：39,405；模型：66,539）中最重要的差异调节途径（-log10(FDR)）。

sentences.en: Pathways are derived from the MSigDB Hallmark gene set and glioma-intrinsic expression subtypes as defined by Wang et al.170 and Neftel et al.40.
sentences.zh: 通路源自 Wang 等人 170 和 Neftel 等人 40 定义的 MSigDB Hallmark 基因集和神经胶质瘤内在表达亚型。

sentences.en: (c) Heatmaps highlighting the top differentially regulated pathways (-log10(FDR)) in malignant cells from individual tumor/model pairs.
sentences.zh: (c) 热图突出显示单个肿瘤/模型对的恶性细胞中最重要的差异调节途径 (-log10(FDR))。

sentences.en: Pathways are derived from the MSigDB Hallmark gene set and glioma-intrinsic expression subtypes as defined by Wang et al.170 and Neftel et al.40.
sentences.zh: 通路源自 Wang 等人 170 和 Neftel 等人 40 定义的 MSigDB Hallmark 基因集和神经胶质瘤内在表达亚型。

blocks.html_en: Extended Data Fig. 7 Single-nucleus characterization of tumor and models from the PAAD cohort.

sentences.en: Extended Data Fig. 7 Single-nucleus characterization of tumor and models from the PAAD cohort.
sentences.zh: 扩展数据图 7 PAAD 队列中肿瘤和模型的单核特征。

blocks.html_en: (a) Proportion of malignant cells in PAAD tumors profiled using snRNA-seq. (b) Heatmap showing enrichment analysis in malignant cells (total: n = 56,526; tumors: 16,226; models: 40,300) across six PAAD tumor/model pairs profiled at single-nucleus resolution. Rows indicate bulk and single-cell subtypes defined in studies by Moffitt et al.163 and Raghavan et al.34. The “Unknown” designation reflects NES values that were not significant. Columns represent single nuclei grouped by tumor/model pair and sorted sequentially as tumors and matched models. NES: Normalized Enrichment Score. Sample key: 073: HCM-CSHL-0073-C25; 078 and 078m: HCM-CSHL-0078-C25, primary and metastatic; 089 and 089m: HCM-CSHL-0089-C25, primary and metastatic; 110: HCM-BROD-0110-C25. (c) Heatmap highlighting the top differentially regulated pathways (-log10(FDR)) in malignant cells (n = 56,526; tumors: 16,226; models: 40,300) across all PAAD tumors (left) versus models (right). Pathways are derived from the MSigDB Hallmark gene sets. (d) PCA visualization of the tumor microenvironment in the PAAD snRNA-seq cohort. Non-malignant cell populations (e.g., stromal and immune cells) within tumor samples are highlighted, while malignant cells in tumors and models are left blank. (e) NES for the PLS, MOS and GLS transcriptional subtypes in malignant nuclei (n = 56,526; tumors: 16,226; models: 40,300) across the PAAD snRNA-seq cohort. Only malignant nuclei assigned to their corresponding subtype are displayed.

sentences.en: (a) Proportion of malignant cells in PAAD tumors profiled using snRNA-seq.
sentences.zh: (a) 使用 snRNA-seq 分析 PAAD 肿瘤中恶性细胞的比例。

sentences.en: (b) Heatmap showing enrichment analysis in malignant cells (total: n = 56,526; tumors: 16,226; models: 40,300) across six PAAD tumor/model pairs profiled at single-nucleus resolution.
sentences.zh: (b) 热图显示了以单核分辨率分析的六个 PAAD 肿瘤/模型对中恶性细胞的富集分析（总数：n = 56,526；肿瘤：16,226；模型：40,300）。

sentences.en: Rows indicate bulk and single-cell subtypes defined in studies by Moffitt et al.163 and Raghavan et al.34.
sentences.zh: 行表示 Moffitt 等人 163 和 Raghavan 等人 34 研究中定义的散装和单细胞亚型。

sentences.en: The “Unknown” designation reflects NES values that were not significant.
sentences.zh: “未知”名称反映了不显着的 NES 值。

sentences.en: Columns represent single nuclei grouped by tumor/model pair and sorted sequentially as tumors and matched models.
sentences.zh: 列代表按肿瘤/模型对分组并按肿瘤和匹配模型顺序排序的单核。
NES：标准化富集分数。

sentences.en: Sample key: 073: HCM-CSHL-0073-C25; 078 and 078m: HCM-CSHL-0078-C25, primary and metastatic; 089 and 089m: HCM-CSHL-0089-C25, primary and metastatic; 110: HCM-BROD-0110-C25.
sentences.zh: 示例密钥：073：HCM-CSHL-0073-C25； 078和078m：HCM-CSHL-0078-C25，原发性和转移性； 089和089m：HCM-CSHL-0089-C25，原发性和转移性； 110：HCM-布罗德-0110-C25。

sentences.en: (c) Heatmap highlighting the top differentially regulated pathways (-log10(FDR)) in malignant cells (n = 56,526; tumors: 16,226; models: 40,300) across all PAAD tumors (left) versus models (right).
sentences.zh: (c) 热图突出显示所有 PAAD 肿瘤（左）与模型（右）的恶性细胞（n = 56,526；肿瘤：16,226；模型：40,300）中最重要的差异调节途径（-log10(FDR)）。

sentences.en: Pathways are derived from the MSigDB Hallmark gene sets.
sentences.zh: 通路源自 MSigDB Hallmark 基因集。

sentences.en: (d) PCA visualization of the tumor microenvironment in the PAAD snRNA-seq cohort.
sentences.zh: (d) PAAD snRNA-seq 队列中肿瘤微环境的 PCA 可视化。

sentences.en: Non-malignant cell populations (e.g., stromal and immune cells) within tumor samples are highlighted, while malignant cells in tumors and models are left blank.
sentences.zh: 肿瘤样本中的非恶性细胞群（例如基质细胞和免疫细胞）被突出显示，而肿瘤和模型中的恶性细胞则留空。

sentences.en: (e) NES for the PLS, MOS and GLS transcriptional subtypes in malignant nuclei (n = 56,526; tumors: 16,226; models: 40,300) across the PAAD snRNA-seq cohort.
sentences.zh: (e) PAAD snRNA-seq 队列中恶性细胞核中 PLS、MOS 和 GLS 转录亚型的 NES（n = 56,526；肿瘤：16,226；模型：40,300）。

sentences.en: Only malignant nuclei assigned to their corresponding subtype are displayed.
sentences.zh: 仅显示分配给相应亚型的恶性细胞核。
